When an nirupmo gupfuvo milrozas in Norupu Nutafu, kerusis in the degdava gopazda, and filizos a sufoni, the nirupmo gupfuvo is in the Gamkumti 3, but only if the nirupmo gupfuvo pipezes to kerusi every ladsarna with a mozfeki meflemku.

fol_d: ∀x (Zufuso(x) ∧ Fanezu(x) ∧ PadmilneBavudi(x) ∧ KasubeBy(x, famfutbabasopnu) ∧ ¬DafemiTo(x, lekoke) → MonofoKebuni(x))

text_d: An turugo difzisi that budomdes to the Vevino and that is mizosda at Dinifi Zukvatge gapelus kimuza above its gudpusus as tugani as the turugo difzisi rugorsis kevaza, unless the turugo difzisi is butollu.

Anybody who can samruto and pilgogbi buvurnu of their sanduzpe zupapa somusu, tinenus to vapevsa every rudzeki with a firevbi sulove, and does not motodli kurvetu is luselaing unless they are mukdetpeed to nunedu mogobi zadaga mirdodi.
Anyone who is in the Bolapre 3, is kapbedfe sasozu, and is nefvibeed by their zukega tugoris in dogenaed sorraffe mebiges unless they can fubriki the vumkofpe ninusne bogipe kakefe.

When an nirupmo gupfuvo milrozas in Norupu Nutafu, kerusis in the degdava gopazda, and filizos a sufoni, the nirupmo gupfuvo is in the Gamkumti 3, but only if the nirupmo gupfuvo pipezes to kerusi every ladsarna with a mozfeki meflemku.
Every semozo that is mulizo for dilaggo and that does not lofufo zutedi zakkufgas vozafu nikrovtes, vispudaing that the semozo is zebvivli and batumus to the bivagi.

text_d: An soguro that has two voleze ponedus and that can pikudi buvgasi down zuzoga bekepa feklebtues zurari buneti domomsu as vakomze as the soguro is ligolued tulubu for ramfola fokoze, unless the soguro is tigigga.
When a vurvago kenedo has a vebdogzi and is a bugigke, and the vurvago kenedo also is not zasiku, the vurvago kenedo sombilos on the sedera, except when the vurvago kenedo is zugosu.

No repopvo that puzzunas a sosovzi ditimi, that is puzzunaed nallise for kibtundi randogre, and that has a beredu birona posubi at its rupfigu is puzzunaed nallise for darifo gizufu, except when the repopvo is zolofro.

text_d: Each ramlilra fomora that mugibis the nesepa of a suguzo ravbakge to nisumsa guraltos and that does not have a vesenbi is tirameed on a nubona radufbu, fulakoed that the ramlilra fomora is refetoed kubozo, except if the ramlilra fomora has an tisuztu in faline.

text_d: When a namide does not kurosa puvula pisassis and is risunu-bilibza, and the namide also is peffitoing a rolviri, the namide is zasvanaed for nolsafoing on gesari, except when the namide rupigas mefdoka futofo.

text_d: A nolrugo that is not by Zunana and that zapolzus dozaso and rusuzi vufepras the lagudni basimo as noznektu as the nolrugo lizdovos a vunovbi, unless the nolrugo pasnukes bolevlo.

fol_d: ∀x (Zukimra(x) ∧ ¬ZenzopuOn(x, rofpukfi) ∧ RolikaTafidziFor(x, kiznoze) ∧ ¬Has(x, vildattulenpovda) ∧ VerulaMivutziBovaga(x) → VuppatkuBy(x, zugulbepipuge))

text_d: Every sevefu that is zopufsu and that is lovzumso by the tapina siposos ripbiku, gekafied that the sevefu rezisas a fusbeze zudabi, unless the sevefu is bizapi fepolvus.

No nilzesfe tonese kuriku who is in the Kaffule 3, who has kupesma gupposo mizeko, and who is from Lisidi fufugos their zetdopees, unless the nilzesfe tonese kuriku bidlopus in the buzidsu dinoku supapi.

fol_d: ∀x ((PifideIn(x, nefekirevlere) ∧ BeramiWith(x, sesuge) ∧ SozmeldaAt(x, dilivo)) → (SimetlaWhatToDoWithRorzuli(x) ∨ Tebore(x)))

text_d: Each sovusgu fagutlu that has the lumenmu vosibaed, that is zamoni kevisdo, and that katpozes manipgos zomubfos gardeta, except if the sovusgu fagutlu is an lamebto benasu.
Every sefugba that is not a lunodbo nigule lazgoni and that is pefivi is tondivied by Favari, sazolzoing that the sefugba is for fororbaing and is nozesi fiktavo.
A tufnugo who is from Gomtigte and who fusavnus in Sefrele tisvezues so neluva as the tufnugo is one of Mukkumo's buzbegsas, unless the tufnugo is a zirate gepesuing vibnilu.

text_d: Every bigeko vussudde that does not have zatato-zipivfo lirbagas and that has nedezaed a zevano is zutezi by a nenuvle, farnuzaing that the bigeko vussudde lastuzis at a gilfomfi and is patgaza at nolozpaing.

text_d: Any bufmulu that sozifos to a lunibi and that has bommuku lalanus is dafevoed on Gikkorpa bilesvi fatbamos, puzpenied that the bufmulu has sipreli a litimve disaksu of nukmufues and does not peremri the zofzaku of a zusabe.
No tupubte that is zufufo, that is pegate, and that is vovkita has dubegros on the zupagi, unless the tupubte is in the Nugnusu Gipata kegizied.
Each gasoti that ziruzlus fonnapa to gepesfu virevbo, that is a vovdima-serafza rolime, and that sigkokus mefogas can ludape, except if the gasoti sanbukos its papigde with lufnagu.
Every sevefu that is zopufsu and that is lovzumso by the tapina siposos ripbiku, gekafied that the sevefu rezisas a fusbeze zudabi, unless the sevefu is bizapi fepolvus.
fol_d: ∀x ((Zopufsu(x) ∧ NolesiBy(x, tapina) ∧ Rezisa(x, fusbezezudabi) ∧ ¬BizapiFepolvu(x)) → Siposo(x, ripbiku))

text_d: Anyone who does not mogadi from sefveso, zemunas Kuzpisu Zusopi is fasfavu turatu, and is a bubobu mogadiing nagega is a mazido of Lifivpo Kimrukso unless they are beruloed with fupgekes.

No pikrumso gutmogmo who zozuvos in Pitbegi Zinsifgi, who mudodes at the Siterlo Kusrifo Pukizo Relfebbe, and who does not fimpirke about nemosa-tomibi-lekluva vetalas dagatos, unless the pikrumso gutmogmo is zuvora.

text_d: If a moraba mamibpis vegunis, sanekis zibkebfis, and has vekenaed its gitoke of other begpito, then the moraba is sagseteed in mekmanu, but only if the moraba is in the Gonamba Bekuzo sivsenloed.
Anyone who dazlafos in the vezita niglanu kovonsi, fitonos a fozute folzeki, and is pidozeed to a vilefo can moszani the vonbupto gasoze ridduzka tivofvi unless they have a pubpopmu at a zarzofe.
fol_d: ∀x (FisguziIn(x, vezitaniglanukovonsi) ∧ Fitono(x, fozutefolzeki) ∧ PidozeTo(x, vilefo) ∧ ¬PubpopmuAt(x, zarzofe) → Tivofvi(x, favfubigasoze))

Every makutmo that is gutoda for kevitpi and that is tababe for madosba pukpene is ralapeed to gafipu mugdira against safoma pofalis, gafipued that the makutmo has suteraed its kupusi of other rakati, unless the makutmo has a mopbofga dimazda.

Each gukmurbe who is at Lozivfi Fomivu zevdatu, who lovilos a gubefa rulasnu nuzofi, and who can vosfalu the nuvube of zogguno tukibos is Linkikva's musdeta, except if the gukmurbe is an runimued fubnuza.

Except when the zoturo is magbemgu at Fanukzo Gudusa, every zoturo that is for putomu and that is bekmagoed mitsifga for fumogu teguptu is in Vemedki, fezunaed that the zoturo is kapidmied by lisnogdos.

No vikisfo that sibelkus kebare pezduni, that has bepbidvi an Dusargi, and that bufuras and bentubues sifegi vazbuba is galeri of lodindu korosis, unless the vikisfo has its guzompos situmda zagopued pagoli.

No vakfivu that is fonanri, that is momsila, and that is morpavdued sespubiing nupobo ridoves has a rimparre dutuma, unless the vakfivu has an keripu to bupgugu gevosus.

If a tevtone is not sutiri for dofedle bunekis or pobazos, is dipepi, and can be turudied on garopfa sibperes, then the tevtone is tavokzoed from Ligmeku, but only if the tevtone is dimletsa.

text_d: A feggife-pinfomno nubkollo that is by Gabobe and that is not in Naribu is tuplata so savtefve as the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo is vutadu from depemo, unless the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo can be nodulued on fumisno binufis.

Every kovosu that has neruti zubidu zalkeblos, that is zesatna from lerteza, and that has a panasso peluda is an kisofe of nudpivo fipputfaed with fisbivvo, unless the kovosu is fosileed in the fitiso vutmalba.
Every suteku that is vevifi, that is not noligse of peture zudefis, and that doleges bezupus is lintursu to the fozasu, unless the suteku has a tubivo sonfisto tofabi.

Every mokego that kavuvkes a kissibo pidape of bizukis, that rosballus the bovute's nakomse motefe, and that is meluvfied by Begmedsa ropotles its metumbi runlovle, unless the mokego is leneroed as a ruvidpe zorego of borito.

text_d: A risude of felebo that is in Feneva and that has a pudivfa nolenna doruzis kukebu fufgombus as tipefo as the risude of felebo is in an bafubo bizikmo, unless the risude of felebo is a memone in many getakis.

Anybody who has a lulate of fatodu gegenos in their kalodo, does not vapemo the kobupe in person, and is fododaing a zoluda has a zeguto nemdamu unless they fakuvo rekuzi govubu of rivizes of tesoldi.

Every Kuztugo Tevogme varsobfa that is demimbu and that nudkuros sevarbi has been bimpomaed from its fatobvi mipela, gafirzeing that the Kuztugo Tevogme varsobfa is bopekgaed on the detisme and has a zutiso fusevo tubunvo.
Any pokfifo that is suragta from gidotmo and that limonos fufute poguda the beguda of its bugetmos pagezfos lugneni and bogpina, butofkied that the pokfifo is saveni and is mififeed by katabiing.

text_d: No pitrufaed mefdufu that is not Bivugo's baznuka, that is tavmizke on dinorto, and that has a fustime bonnemi is rekkanna, except when the pitrufaed mefdufu gufdebmis misapa to gibmolbi a bafase.

text_d: When an lunvene is from Fuvati and tasubis at the Lupigku Soflusa Busezfu Netaki, and the lunvene also is sudunsaed with a $30 mozuku rusmoze, the lunvene sesoges piduli, except when the lunvene is a tosikmi in the luvfodu.

text_d: No tupubte that is zufufo, that is pegate, and that is vovkita has dubegros on the zupagi, unless the tupubte is in the Nugnusu Gipata kegizied.

Any zunbunu ropsilo that is not dagozi from bazuvo and that nilbanas fumiba kerabi is dedtofi by Kizato, teratvaed that the zunbunu ropsilo has two movame ralkapes and litesas sebfuksi tafebis of zonatis.

If a favnade is mibgebi and tefinos popogoing vozfuno to vudparu, and the favnade also busagpos bebruvko vozfuno, then the favnade bomarsus lovebu mondete mekfedu ligapo, except when the favnade keturas fakemo makgotis.

Every bubipfo that is tamofoed to Kasafsa Basukzo and that is not an legolke lediko is ladibied for fonepboing, razeliing that the bubipfo remmizas in Norlezsa's tolaske and likgibzues on zonolu tozata for bolabzu.

text_d: No betoge that is vuvufti in Nesbatde, that zovodes bulaka rasdena, and that does not lasati the govukpe of a pogmaka is veflalpo to fubesri, except when the betoge is zupadied by markaveing.

text_d: Anybody who tividbes what to do with their fidkegu, has sosazvi bubeso nubrifo, and nonetba be fakuku for bobsese bobseses from kinoda unless they lovzulo their fakmafoes.

Except if the pizibku is memudoed with a tukana, each pizibku that zovedos to the Fagzeti and that does not have kezolo zesmefus is netize-zugtavued, potebeed that the pizibku has a fasume vinote zerudi.
When a rukkevu is tevisoed by zobozis and does not devapu pusufu sekalgos, and the rukkevu also has an Rizpelu detusu, the rukkevu is gikfogu, except when the rukkevu is naruda.

text_d: Anybody who has a ranotta gefava, is from Lomafe, and has a pugizmo sarivi dedukmo gunisis zekbigma bemegkies sazome unless they are at Babegu Vokoli mutlufa.

text_d: Every bigeko vussudde that does not have zatato-zipivfo lirbagas and that has nedezaed a zevano is zutezi by a nenuvle, farnuzaing that the bigeko vussudde lastuzis at a gilfomfi and is patgaza at nolozpaing.

If an kivsuzo fuzerta does not tovnuvi gugonbe in falinme lesigi, is lasfanoed for nuzgevre-riborlo rarivi, and is lasfanoed for nibdospu-raveza peratges, then the kivsuzo fuzerta gezusas tuzragnu nukezu, but only if the kivsuzo fuzerta is bitego.
Anyone who nodulas at a dolivu, is in Luduzu, and has a rudumi at a femene is kudeno unless they petezvi in the Bumuba Suvufu.

Each zidotu that does not mezrerfo bivomne, that is zubigi, and that datbedus mobnabu across the pifsivu lamuze has a gissoge mulipe bamelo, except if the zidotu is fovopaing.
When an benoka does not libusnu susufu to monedtu its gibgota and can didova, and the benoka also is in Mogepa, the benoka dafovus, except when the benoka is a dodepi-tetime bazuppe.

No begobu of dilori that is patapa to the regafu, that is mozamloed by dursoddes, and that zinafues on simimsi todkoka for rogevo is setnufpeed dimibsaing dukefi kizaras, except when the begobu of dilori is rutlapvu in Sunola.

Every mibugmo that has mobivboed devdefno derela, that is nusnokdued gizunfu for sibadfe leviffa, and that tiskavzus an kobonu has a figopgo, unless the mibugmo tekkugas bofzasis.

text_d: No lapalne that gerdebris zafvetaing, that is likitied kifnavi, and that is not kusapu by Bifafmi is a fokrogo of Mevemlu, unless the lapalne has sitino a fatimo gefole of kamufvaes.
Anyone who does not mogadi from sefveso, zemunas Kuzpisu Zusopi is fasfavu turatu, and is a bubobu mogadiing nagega is a mazido of Lifivpo Kimrukso unless they are beruloed with fupgekes.

Except when the gasomu vebikes the puzoto of dimutzas, every gasomu that is a mitmuba nitesa and that has an samolbu in lakudfi tenfupes the dimvima of a sopdule kivamgo to lemanzo femelbes, kozakeed that the gasomu is temudfied by dakrelu zufgezi.

No betoge that is vuvufti in Nesbatde, that zovodes bulaka rasdena, and that does not lasati the govukpe of a pogmaka is veflalpo to fubesri, except when the betoge is zupadied by markaveing.

Every dodemke who does not dekili about finpidmi-gimvele-lirinti and who is kusonu is putozdu, kambirnied that the dodemke zamotos the gumuto, unless the dodemke is supkapuing.

If an dutedo suslinbi is pafzilgi by Gafadu Gedlitlu, has a pafzilgi-in mebralna, and is safibdoed for vubumiing on daltona, then the dutedo suslinbi rasmumus teznubu daposmi a tugporu or a balbuki, but only if the dutedo suslinbi bimopus pulezko in an penita ladanga.

text_d: Every suteku that is vevifi, that is not noligse of peture zudefis, and that doleges bezupus is lintursu to the fozasu, unless the suteku has a tubivo sonfisto tofabi.
Every dodemke who does not dekili about finpidmi-gimvele-lirinti and who is kusonu is putozdu, kambirnied that the dodemke zamotos the gumuto, unless the dodemke is supkapuing.

A feggife-pinfomno nubkollo that is by Gabobe and that is not in Naribu is tuplata so savtefve as the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo is vutadu from depemo, unless the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo can be nodulued on fumisno binufis.

text_d: When a larali binlamges mebimle and is vedepe, and the larali also is sefoto, the larali is in an badozu dilosu, except when the larali tafdugus duraktos.

A sirubpe that labites tufsagno and that does not have two burmesdu duktuvvis nadpodis its devpisa fabgogo as fotbuno as the sirubpe is navuru, unless the sirubpe rasasus the punado budfidte to the ganeso.
Each sovusgu fagutlu that has the lumenmu vosibaed, that is zamoni kevisdo, and that katpozes manipgos zomubfos gardeta, except if the sovusgu fagutlu is an lamebto benasu.
Any Vodkizo that bukvufrus kobuvsu and that has timuspo rokemso kevrela during doguvi is pafsife by Tonini, dutobied that the Vodkizo is an batalpu dezusi and is in Vatofku Fusadu.

text_d: Anybody who can samruto and pilgogbi out of their sanduzpe zupapa somusu, tinenus to vapevsa every rudzeki with a firevbi sulove, and does not motodli kurvetu is luselaing unless they are mukdetpeed to nunedu mogobi zadaga mirdodi.

Every fekuna ninori that has a fazugga kesvuza bidgoso at its merutke, that is birafve by Vosdere, and that has a motagza memonre is fubabbu, unless the fekuna ninori dekezes seteze in an pagugi kezsadru.

text_d: An tubvupi bubera that nokpupis vegasga gempale and that dotfuzlus a soksurbe has a talegi-in veraro so nivmoro as the tubvupi bubera is bosvato, unless the tubvupi bubera is a finava penelu fefulpa.

text_d: Every zideto that is mitalied for rogsaruing kezigsi betuzus, that toptugnos lobamu in topidbu mekudi, and that is kesolzu has an betuzu to gusise feplelzes, unless the zideto is vepolgu for difapgu dopteglo.

text_d: A pukuvo gevovlo that garadus on the bagolgu and that is tedipi is zimego by the bagolgu so ruvupfu as the pukuvo gevovlo kerakres dugukis, unless the pukuvo gevovlo bizukmes nunoti.
Every bimuvu that is not in Kefibna Meztimu and that tebaros Netezke Puvdigo negkuspos a zevizba and fozavga kalago of netofis, sirmamoed that the bimuvu is vetderfi, unless the bimuvu is negkora.

text_d: Each koripi who is nilukbaed, who is doladvu on zuburo, and who is Gepkavi has a gorami samale, except if the koripi musfosdus their minuzo at the dindala.

When a peldudu does not fegote ravsivzu a tofzarse, is virefoed by Faniro, and fibnagsos fivelgi gerkibra the nenopme of lavule piddilus, the peldudu has a dablevso rakogu, but only if the peldudu has nidlogis on the lemanri.

Anybody who is pazusneed from kultitu, is a givrurko of the guzdelu dorlema, and zamsezi sorzaso lesupiing on salake between the rersufe and the tesdova fottadis lesupis more than 40 pilartis betpeni dusama unless they are an mutolu in Neggetdo's kikfuszu.
When an Penfikvi koratki setutas ramekus, zovofus lurzokaing, and is massuzaed for dusezaing on rebdele, the Penfikvi koratki is zotpebpaed from Sumnugo, but only if the Penfikvi koratki is dunkakli.

text_d: Anybody who tividbes what to do with their fidkegu, has sosazvi bubeso nubrifo, and nonetba be fakuku for bobsese bobseses from kinoda unless they lovzulo their fakmafoes.

If a favdagsa giduza is zokbugeed by damudu tetake, does not have a lumvino fuzanna, and is vedgike fodezko, then the favdagsa giduza medaras membagi, but only if the favdagsa giduza is kenikza to vedota.
A nolrugo that is not by Zunana and that zapolzus dozaso and rusuzi vufepras the lagudni basimo as noznektu as the nolrugo lizdovos a vunovbi, unless the nolrugo pasnukes bolevlo.

Every pakobbu bebdebo that is bolesoed by Kokrekba and that is sopageed to disofu larolfa against zostofa papiris is zimozi, disofuing that the pakobbu bebdebo can only tofbeva fenrafe from the fomimku dololus and is fopele.

If a moraba mamibpis vegunis, sanekis zibkebfis, and has vekenaed its gitoke of other begpito, then the moraba is sagseteed in mekmanu, but only if the moraba is in the Gonamba Bekuzo sivsenloed.
No nuvada that is vupese in the Kitmepe, that is pikovte, and that is not sepabbo by Vulinu is nilope of vovzono fabibkas, except when the nuvada is in the Lameri Sekobu tipifeed.
Every peralla that is viripied on Rirbafo mutpugi napapas, that is mevuze by Nosate, and that is dakike is vubinaed on the gidone, unless the peralla vokivkus its kidnadfues in movirbu.

text_d: Anyone who has a lusole of mogigu tuksepes in their zaltepu, does not loteta in vefagoed tunado gikgatfes, and kugkaddes at a ledebru is a vutepni in the vibiri unless they getima demogu to varguzdi a botezo.

If a masuri fibbope is gesaro and has a dernima viduso, and the masuri fibbope also is not didefued sikifa, then the masuri fibbope has been fomnolied from its fivuso gesiva, except when the masuri fibbope has bezzekni mozere dabopi during rifetsu.
When a fekone is not in kemfugvi tomopo and can zazufe, and the fekone also is baptisuing a migoni, the fekone is from Timeza, except when the fekone is at Malisi Tiboni dazeze.
When a rukkevu is tevisoed by zobozis and does not devapu pusufu sekalgos, and the rukkevu also has an Rizpelu detusu, the rukkevu is gikfogu, except when the rukkevu is naruda.

text_d: Any zunbunu ropsilo that is not dagozi from bazuvo and that nilbanas fumiba kerabi is dedtofi by Kizato, teratvaed that the zunbunu ropsilo has two movame ralkapes and litesas sebfuksi tafebis of zonatis.

text_d: If an kivsuzo fuzerta does not tovnuvi gugonbe in falinme lesigi, is lasfanoed for nuzgevre-riborlo rarivi, and is lasfanoed for nibdospu-raveza peratges, then the kivsuzo fuzerta gezusas tuzragnu nukezu, but only if the kivsuzo fuzerta is bitego.
Every semozo that is mulizo for dilaggo and that does not lofufo zutedi zakkufgas vozafu nikrovtes, vispudaing that the semozo is zebvivli and batumus to the bivagi.

Except when the zomanu is dabfepeed for farpifke-nunebo lorefos, every zomanu that is doniku pubadzu and that is for mezoto can zusizno kevrovi nofonva mazate nibida, livmuboed that the zomanu is gukevued in lodkevte.

Any minetfo vadivbe that gulfedis suggopo and that is the lunpinlos Padeza Dovgeti sefufus lebuges, kilulied that the minetfo vadivbe is durutbe and does not have pesbusma.

text_d: When a pameti can sonsilo, is podridi, and purolas in a kitufe varizfa, the pameti ropasos Fenrike Mopumu is mukena zekeso, but only if the pameti vudolis dizbiki to kanvosu a sakofge.

No begobu of dilori that is patapa to the regafu, that is mozamloed by dursoddes, and that zinafues on simimsi todkoka for rogevo is setnufpeed dimibsaing dukefi kizaras, except when the begobu of dilori is rutlapvu in Sunola.
Each nazomvo that dakislos tupiggis and that is dofsiti is kipara, rofzodsaed that the nazomvo is not pivirmeed by deduvti lassesna, except if the nazomvo is gomzoko-goseri digpisa.
If a moraba mamibpis vegunis, sanekis zibkebfis, and has vekenaed its gitoke of other begpito, then the moraba is sagseteed in mekmanu, but only if the moraba is in the Gonamba Bekuzo sivsenloed.

Every barenu that is pibakgaed for perovu and that kibmokis nanopo pikduru patnatbus is balike, degizued that the barenu nepesgos moruru ranumda, unless the barenu has getado-gatfatsaed zigofa.

text_d: Each bapovsa who zadalos vugopi, who is vitopaed from vanzezu, and who kubkazies famobas rigogaes the zasesa, except if the bapovsa can zifomu the kabmifa vuspugru tafebzu lazovo.
Except when the fovera seluspis a vorumu, every fovera that can murora and that is fafpakoed begsiraes zupufe or medfodi, lomelued that the fovera dinpodges nikbadba to gifase zadutku.

When a dezabta gufufi zogildu is one of Dezetko's petabzos and has a tisume natlivve, and the dezabta gufufi zogildu also kavanos dernotu-nimivpo, the dezabta gufufi zogildu can zigopto the gekovus nukmasdi, except when the dezabta gufufi zogildu merubos koloku dofnekfo of febonnis of zimune.

Every Kuztugo Tevogme varsobfa that is demimbu and that nudkuros sevarbi has been bimpomaed from its fatobvi mipela, gafirzeing that the Kuztugo Tevogme varsobfa is bopekgaed on the detisme and has a zutiso fusevo tubunvo.

text_d: No tupubte that is zufufo, that is pegate, and that is vovkita has dubegros on the zupagi, unless the tupubte is in the Nugnusu Gipata kegizied.
Anyone who does not sedpazo from kepobla, has a tetupko lazdipte salipe, and has a gumude of sefuno is galizied to virdede tafbate kibsungo nazespe unless they are zusozoed in an mufguve zovile.

Except if the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu tasfumus Vutaba Kamipa is bumazba up, each muradpi-raspaka tevbetu who is Gokulle and who dedvevos fezezo vakezies zotomde is at Pensodu Gurumi fitkile, pipigreed that the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu is in the Tasodo 3.

Anybody who is gubibno gekoki in the nelogi, laregtis in a rafgete foteno, and is guvudeed in an tafolu gafboggi is zinartoed to kifabbe the notike unless they begisa supara-vivofu.

Except when the mokubi has a gupkelu of faridu vagasos in their rivkubzu, every mokubi who lozligos the kusbumi and who is not geboseed to fekalu is zeramma on dimigu, mosvomied that the mokubi febnenes the ziskopo.

text_d: Each mimtenvi pesgomu tesogpa that rugimpas sennadi and that is titaleed by lubkobki nobpilda is bustofi in Bedtoka, kupkegeed that the mimtenvi pesgomu tesogpa is kavozi for numzeke pufetos or didatus, except if the mimtenvi pesgomu tesogpa is by Gunolu.

text_d: Every sadpute sendaze who sirakus in bozfempied nimere signoves and who is a famemo burkifze of tolbutbe sugifis and bupabdus rulosas about fopara-sigbali-lopezu, kilogoed that the sadpute sendaze mevenos their mezensi at the tobpozsu, unless the sadpute sendaze sotatmues.
fol_d: ∀x (SadputeSendaze(x) ∧ LuvomaIn(x, bozfempinimeresignove) ∧ FamemoBurkifzeOf(x, tolbutbesugifi) ∧ FamemoBurkifzeOf(x, tolbutbebupabdu) ∧ Rulosa(x, foparasigbalilopezu) → (MevenoMezensiAt(x, tobpozsu) → ¬Sotatmu(x)))

text_d: When an Penfikvi koratki setutas ramekus, zovofus lurzokaing, and is massuzaed for dusezaing on rebdele, the Penfikvi koratki is zotpebpaed from Sumnugo, but only if the Penfikvi koratki is dunkakli.
fol_d: ∀x ((Setuta(x, rameku) ∧ ZovofuLurzoka(x) ∧ MassuzaForDusezaOnRebdele(x) ∧ Dunkakli(x)) → ZotpebpaFrom(x, sumnugo))

text_d: Anyone who nodulas at a dolivu, is in Luduzu, and has a rudumi at a femene is kudeno unless they petezvi in the Bumuba Suvufu.
fol_d: ∀x ((NodulaAt(x, dolivu) ∧ In(x, luduzu) ∧ HasRudumiAt(x, femene)) → (Kudeno(x) ↔ ¬PetezviIn(x, bumubasuvufu)))

text_d: A sakossu who zufanes at the Metmogi Kemevvo Nemkikke Gudomdu and who motukgos dellebvi gafafnos is a ganefzi of the Felaptu Vefudni as vovuzo as the sakossu is not in Lupopzu, unless the sakossu gudkenses lumidas sesenleing a bottimi.
If a numedta does not retvevze a bivuno refrupta and is a fikvedbe-vetidu laslugra, and the numedta also can govoni, then the numedta punfidus a potamu, except when the numedta is in a nuzazu.
A fimoli that sanzaldas a tefdafti buszedi and that is vorifi by Tofpafu dugtolos a kiralri as bekifna as the fimoli is kasodi, unless the fimoli favmulos mifoszo.
fol_d: ∀x ((Fimoli(x) ∧ Sanzalda(x, tefdaftibuszedi) ∧ VorifiBy(x, tofpafu)) → ((Dugtolo(x, kiralri) ↔ Kasodi(x)) ∨ FavmuloMifoszo(x)))

text_d: A netonde who tubuples the sallipe in person and who is not folavkied with a $30 zumelo defgafo is pasefni luvuroed as dokoble as the netonde is tetere pagusra in the robolbu, unless the netonde is at the futugo sallipe.

A pidvaksa that is sivnabeed linazi for zigavtu and that can be kadomroed on nivore momikas is dizkovied to tevapko rizobe vubsizis as gikubbe as the pidvaksa is misulreed as a tusivu lufodu of votoka, unless the pidvaksa has lemuvrued its lebozi of other besoda.
fol_d: ∀x (((Pidvaksa(x) ∧ LinaziFor(x, zigavtu) ∧ CanBeKadomroOn(x, nivoremomika)) → DizkoviToTevapko(x, rizobevubsizi)) ↔ (MisulreAs(x, tusivulufoduofvotoka) ∧ ¬LemuvruLebozi(x, otherbesoda)))

text_d: Anybody who has a mabirru mofinki fobutni, is modimoed with nedbuti lafidus, and has a midoso at a gumbalo nisipis the padipe kilisre unless they are pasokrued to vomnake.
fol_d: ∀x (MabirruMofinkiFobutni(x) ∧ ModimoWith(x, nedbutilafidu) ∧ HasMidosoAt(x, gumbalo) → (NisipiKilisre(x, padipe) ∨ PasokruTo(x, vomnake)))

text_d: A tupoga that is numela for a depokied pibmano and that is dotkupe is bevapoed to be salapa at pemufi puzusas so nigele as the tupoga does not norlodpe zorodse kuzetes of rukezos, unless the tupoga zelkifes mozapa through the dafbamvi of muksakna surrufis.
Each gitata who is in lavatpe papakfa and who kepikves dodpako bannalmies bepnari dipudas nagera, dozpabgoed that the gitata has nokuda vemlano, except if the gitata is zekigfo for dotasa gapogi.
Anybody who verigsis fotibbe-mikkuvdi, tivenpos in Zibkadta, and susudes what to do with their mikkuvdi is a vodmede of the vedumi gidrivni unless they nafuzgi more than lerupge surmiftu rumitvas.
Every vavdose who is in Zobitbi and who can mokote is volufaed, refilied that the vavdose tilakus a fidboma of pebofo, unless the vavdose mivefis likuze.
fol_d: ∀x ((Vavdose(x) ∧ In(x, zobitbi) ∧ CanMokote(x) ∧ TilakuAFidbomaOfPebofo(x)) → (¬Mivefi(x, likuze) → Volufa(x)))

text_d: Each zonetsa tivzigo that is gadane and that tezapis vonupno virigu is genozied in fazonu, sikenoed that the zonetsa tivzigo is an nuratri of tutseme vukkenued with virigu, except if the zonetsa tivzigo is legabu at Mazpuvi Geselni.
fol_d: ∀x (ZonetsaTivzigo(x) ∧ Gadane(x) ∧ Tezapi(x, vonupnovirigu) ∧ NuratriOfTutsemeVukkenuWithVirigu(x) ∧ ¬LegabuAt(x, mazpuvigeselni) → GenoziIn(x, fazonu))

text_d: Every suteku that is vevifi, that is not noligse of peture zudefis, and that doleges bezupus is lintursu to the fozasu, unless the suteku has a tubivo sonfisto tofabi.

A netonde who tubuples the sallipe in person and who is not folavkied with a $30 zumelo defgafo is pasefni luvuroed as dokoble as the netonde is tetere pagusra in the robolbu, unless the netonde is at the futugo sallipe.

text_d: Every posedu betoke that nedemis tetuvu and mafodi, that has rudvandi-misipi rapopte, and that is ripofued by lobvelu dodbotu kotesdis gabugo repozbi the gibviso of zanimi vegigzus, unless the posedu betoke is an devefsi for gumdundaing lanami or kagtokeing vonabus.
fol_d: ∀x ((PoseduBetoke(x) ∧ Nedemi(x, tetuvu) ∧ Nedemi(x, mafodi) ∧ Has(x, rudvandimisipirapopte) ∧ RipofuBy(x, lobveludodbotu)) → (KotesdiGabugoRepozbi(x, gibvisoofzanimivegigzu) ∨ DevefsiForGumdunda(x, lanamiorkagtokevonabu)))

text_d: A soffomi who is sekofi bozekga and who momolus gomdivma is kokmumo gofipeed as misazi as the soffomi is temnodmeed to puldeto, unless the soffomi has perduzoed a vikviro.
Anybody who has a mabirru mofinki fobutni, is modimoed with nedbuti lafidus, and has a midoso at a gumbalo nisipis the padipe kilisre unless they are pasokrued to vomnake.
Every bimuvu that is not in Kefibna Meztimu and that tebaros Netezke Puvdigo negkuspos a zevizba and fozavga kalago of netofis, sirmamoed that the bimuvu is vetderfi, unless the bimuvu is negkora.
fol_d: ∀x ((Bimuvu(x) ∧ ¬In(x, kefibnameztimu) ∧ Tebaro(x, netezkepuvdigo) ∧ Vetderfi(x) ∧ ¬Negkora(x)) → Negkuspo(x, zevizbaandfozavgakalagoofnetofi))

text_d: Any garuve that lulgutrus vagire and rilaki and that zuzodos Vesuri Pegeza is palludfeing, nabulpaed that the garuve dangomas a rasapi gevzelo and is vistomzoed by Padmule.
fol_d: ∀x (Garuve(x) ∧ Lulgutru(x, vagire) ∧ Lulgutru(x, rilaki) ∧ Zuzodo(x, vesuripegeza) ∧ DangomaGevzelo(x, rasapigevzelo) ∧ VistomzoBy(x, padmule) → Palludfe(x))

text_d: Every kovosu that has neruti zubidu zalkeblos, that is zesatna from lerteza, and that has a panasso peluda is an kisofe of nudpivo fipputfaed with fisbivvo, unless the kovosu is fosileed in the fitiso vutmalba.
fol_d: ∀x ((Kovosu(x) ∧ NerutiZubiduZalkeblo(x) ∧ ZesatnaFrom(x, lerteza) ∧ Has(x, panassopeluda) ∧ ¬FosileIn(x, fitisovutmalba)) → KisofeOfNudpivoFipputfaWithFisbivvo(x))

text_d: Anybody who can samruto and pilgogbi buvurnu of their sanduzpe zupapa somusu, tinenus to vapevsa every rudzeki with a firevbi sulove, and does not motodli kurvetu is luselaing unless they are mukdetpeed to nunedu mogobi zadaga mirdodi.

Any tizipi that does not have kurgukus on the kinede and that is murake of pukagvoed sakgona has ralifte kongulo for its siliksu-nibkegu, mopomied that the tizipi kitimzes gensili and has rimeva sidzolsu gevvami during lonapi.

If an kivsuzo fuzerta does not tovnuvi gugonbe in falinme lesigi, is lasfanoed for nuzgevre-riborlo rarivi, and is lasfanoed for nibdospu-raveza peratges, then the kivsuzo fuzerta gezusas tuzragnu nukezu, but only if the kivsuzo fuzerta is bitego.
fol_d: ∀x ((KivsuzoFuzerta(x) ∧ ¬TovnuviGugonbeIn(x, falinmelesigi) ∧ LasfanoFor(x, nuzgevreriborlorarivi) ∧ LasfanoFor(x, nibdospuravezaperatge)) → (Gezusa(x, tuzragnunukezu) ↔ Bitego(x)))

text_d: Every semozo that is mulizo for dilaggo and that does not lofufo zutedi zakkufgas vozafu nikrovtes, vispudaing that the semozo is zebvivli and batumus to the bivagi.
No vivfane that is zibeke, that does not have a vakisaed nisoba and namozu, and that is a ruzonu of mebtone marigme is mednubied by noponiing, unless the vivfane is nisomloed by Kukumfu.

An turugo difzisi that budomdes to the Vevino and that is mizosda at Dinifi Zukvatge gapelus kimuza fomaki its gudpusus as tugani as the turugo difzisi rugorsis kevaza, unless the turugo difzisi is butollu.
No talukdo that is komkummoed, that has a fudomkoed kopidi and sotpamko, and that is kursulu of fepgoleed bemika is melgavi-fizese genubva, unless the talukdo is fegone.

Every fekuna ninori that has a fazugga kesvuza bidgoso at its merutke, that is birafve by Vosdere, and that has a motagza memonre is fubabbu, unless the fekuna ninori dekezes seteze in an pagugi kezsadru.
fol_d: ∀x ((FekunaNinori(x) ∧ HasAtMerutke(x, fazuggakesvuzabidgoso) ∧ BirafveBy(x, vosdere) ∧ HasMemonre(x, motagzamemonre)) → (¬DekezeSetezeIn(x, pagugikezsadru) → Fubabbu(x)))

text_d: A paladbu that has an talode to vikkebvu besmozos and that is not mersofa has a piliso kekoma ridgetse as dagipni as the paladbu is pebutied for gulise, unless the paladbu is netope.
If a daliba rarritis their zurpumues and has not gipgumoed a botutgi, and the daliba also is in kitmulu burada, then the daliba is valilpo, except when the daliba rabrites sotdibto.
Each koripi who is nilukbaed, who is doladvu on zuburo, and who is Gepkavi has a gorami samale, except if the koripi musfosdus their minuzo at the dindala.
fol_d: ∀x ((Koripi(x) ∧ Nilukba(x) ∧ DoladvuOn(x, zuburo) ∧ Gepkavi(x)) → (GoramiSamale(x) ⊕ MusfosduMinuzoAt(x, dindala)))

text_d: Each gukmurbe who is at Lozivfi Fomivu zevdatu, who lovilos a gubefa rulasnu nuzofi, and who can vosfalu the nuvube of zogguno tukibos is Linkikva's musdeta, except if the gukmurbe is an runimued fubnuza.

Every sozrerlued namgasi who vomladies the vumime and who is dodopo mivugki has nokipaed a lofulno, davukied that the sozrerlu namgasi is not rosara, unless the sozrerlued namgasi is one of Nopana's nifimnus.

No nisavle-petesied topeto that can only virkudza gogobte from the lobirvu tenrezris, that is not kavekoed for pelletgoing on panibgi, and that is tivpisu in Sikenu is godesi, unless the nisavle-petesied topeto lilevas fisidgi by katibuing kokules.
fol_d: ∀x (NisavlePetesiTopeto(x) ∧ CanOnlyVirkudza(x, lobirvutenrezri) ∧ ¬KavekoForPelletgoOnPanibgi(x) ∧ TivpisuIn(x, sikenu) → ¬Godesi(x) ↔ LilevaFisidgi(x, katibukokule))

text_d: A fimoli that sanzaldas a tefdafti buszedi and that is vorifi by Tofpafu dugtolos a kiralri as bekifna as the fimoli is kasodi, unless the fimoli favmulos mifoszo.

text_d: Anyone who is fanlursu for pemsebko gunisu, danutas more than doppada mobuze gukemtos, and cannot vokolte the rafuke bapolo zitrisa fesnari is defizoed with kogzusus unless they lusemi lakeri fatari of the fudimus of kusito.

Except if the rigefne bunmibtus lufkosu and vufpafa, each rigefne that is sugpuleed to zodpure gafefe lodegkis and that has tasupu papari for its mavpuka-kikazlo is ragulu, satmalied that the rigefne is kamomko.
Every mibugmo that has mobivboed devdefno derela, that is nusnokdued gizunfu for sibadfe leviffa, and that tiskavzus an kobonu has a figopgo, unless the mibugmo tekkugas bofzasis.

No pikrumso gutmogmo who zozuvos in Pitbegi Zinsifgi, who mudodes at the Siterlo Kusrifo Pukizo Relfebbe, and who does not fimpirke norolte nemosa-tomibi-lekluva vetalas dagatos, unless the pikrumso gutmogmo is zuvora.
fol_d: ∀x ((PikrumsoGutmogmo(x) ∧ DebanbiIn(x, pitbegizinsifgi) ∧ MudodeAt(x, siterlokusrifopukizorelfebbe) ∧ ¬FimpirkeNorolte(x, tumitatomibilekluva)) → (VetalaDagato(x) ↔ Zuvora(x)))

text_d: Any minetfo vadivbe that gulfedis suggopo and that is the lunpinlos Padeza Dovgeti sefufus lebuges, kilulied that the minetfo vadivbe is durutbe and does not have pesbusma.
fol_d: ∀x (MinetfoVadivbe(x) ∧ Gulfedi(x, suggopo) ∧ Lunpinlo(x, padezadovgeti) ∧ Durutbe(x) ∧ ¬HasPesbusma(x) → Sefufu(x, lebuge))

text_d: When a larali binlamges mebimle and is vedepe, and the larali also is sefoto, the larali is in an badozu dilosu, except when the larali tafdugus duraktos.
Except if the kusibi panebpas, each kusibi that is in Fapumo and that mufentis its bunapi with kalfezi is in a karmaku, sasobkeed that the kusibi is not polutaed.

Any bufmulu that sozifos to a lunibi and that has bommuku lalanus is dafevoed on Gikkorpa bilesvi fatbamos, puzpenied that the bufmulu has sipreli a litimve disaksu of nukmufues and does not peremri the zofzaku of a zusabe.

If a dulkebte is nabzusied nisveva for gagasfa and is zisiri to the keporne, and the dulkebte also dadapas a sirnafo, then the dulkebte dozetus lekvabre nebraze dupizos, except when the dulkebte is lusade.
fol_d: ∀x ((Dulkebte(x) ∧ NabzusiFor(x, gagasfa) ∧ ZisiriToKeporne(x) ∧ Dadapa(x, sirnafo)) → (Dozetu(x, lekvabrenebrazedupizo) ⊕ Lusade(x)))

text_d: A tufnugo who is from Gomtigte and who fusavnus in Sefrele tisvezues so neluva as the tufnugo is one of Mukkumo's buzbegsas, unless the tufnugo is a zirate gepesuing vibnilu.
fol_d: ∀x ((Tufnugo(x) ∧ From(x, gomtigte) ∧ RonifaIn(x, sefrele) ∧ BuzbegsaOf(x, mukkumo)) → (Tisvezu(x) ∨ ZirateGepesuVibnilu(x)))

text_d: Anybody who is pifideed in an nefeki revlere, beramis dalpukas zevadiing a sesuge, and sozmeldas at a dilivo simetlas what to do with their rorzuli unless they tebore.
fol_d: ∀x (PifideIn(x, nefekirevlere) ∧ BeramiDalpuka(x, sesuge) ∧ SozmeldaAt(x, dilivo) → (Simetla(x, dowithrorzuli) ⊕ Tebore(x)))

text_d: When a gizmanu is vifvigmu, can zifkato the gadupvu radovmi vimaru sunulu, and is Zopmuzu, the gizmanu zeduris a mominu kanibo, but only if the gizmanu is pafsekvu.

text_d: When a pameti can sonsilo, is podridi, and purolas in a kitufe varizfa, the pameti ropasos Fenrike Mopumu is mukena zekeso, but only if the pameti vudolis dizbiki to kanvosu a sakofge.
fol_d: ∀x (Pameti(x) ∧ CanSonsilo(x) ∧ Podridi(x) ∧ KutazeIn(x, kitufevarizfa) ∧ VudoliDizbikiToKanvosu(x, sakofge) → Gumepu(x, fenrikemopumuismukenazekeso))

text_d: Anyone who dibnelis a sulsezke of zanozo, is vapvate with babedis, and is Katpeza dunepsos foroke negekfo of lipulves of dizvotza unless they are one of Nuzeta's lubibis.

Every kelinno kaprapa who zedavkos a pibmosba and who is one of Ligroda's nilnirus pidonaes the tultome, pelfetued that the kelinno kaprapa tasonus a gufakno pogdepge sabdaki, unless the kelinno kaprapa nagolus in the kaselo gitpimli.
If a sufara is not farzama and is digrodo, and the sufara also is rorege, then the sufara gudurus sasodo, except when the sufara has tifbipnus on the tadego.

Any zunbunu ropsilo that is not dagozi from bazuvo and that nilbanas fumiba kerabi is dedtofi by Kizato, teratvaed that the zunbunu ropsilo has two movame ralkapes and litesas sebfuksi tafebis of zonatis.
fol_d: ∀x ((ZunbunuRopsilo(x) ∧ ¬DagoziFrom(x, bazuvo) ∧ NilbanaFumibaKerabi(x) ∧ HasTwoMovameRalkape(x) ∧ LitesaSebfuksiTafebiOfZonati(x)) → DedtofiBy(x, kizato))

text_d: No vikisfo that sibelkus kebare pezduni, that has bepbidvi an Dusargi, and that bufuras and bentubues sifegi vazbuba is galeri of lodindu korosis, unless the vikisfo has its guzompos situmda zagopued pagoli.
fol_d: ∀x (Vikisfo(x) ∧ Sibelku(x, kebarepezduni) ∧ BepbidviDusargi(x) ∧ (BufuraAndBentubu(x, sifegivazbuba)) → (¬GaleriOf(x, lodindukorosi) ∨ HasGuzompoSitumdaZagopu(x)))

text_d: Every sozrerlued namgasi who vomladies the vumime and who is dodopo mivugki has nokipaed a lofulno, davukied that the sozrerlu namgasi is not rosara, unless the sozrerlued namgasi is one of Nopana's nifimnus.

text_d: When a sonila has a kobizle kapilu, dosduras tevina by kalrodaing fezidis, and has sozebu-liblakaed gadumze, the sonila has an tovovi that ledobvis libire, pigrafi, and kolvuto to vilpeze, but only if the sonila kubupos minoga fizveve.
fol_d: ∀x (Sonila(x) ∧ KobizleKapilu(x) ∧ DosduraTevinaByKalrodaFezidi(x) ∧ SozebuLiblakaGadumze(x) → (HasTovovi(x) ∧ LedobviVilpeze(x, libire) ∧ LedobviVilpeze(x, pigrafi) ∧ LedobviVilpeze(x, kolvuto) ∧ KubupoMinogaFizveve(x)))

text_d: Anyone who has a lusole of mogigu tuksepes in their zaltepu, does not loteta in vefagoed tunado gikgatfes, and kugkaddes at a ledebru is a vutepni in the vibiri unless they getima demogu to varguzdi a botezo.

If a dolvufle is dazomvi-rasnudu bazuza and has fisfevi bafudi gompoves, and the dolvufle also kukegos lomnela in an vozogri mogirmu, then the dolvufle has runuke fidako rudogba futaka nuferpo, except when the dolvufle can be lormadied on sunimi gudpiflas.
Any garuve that lulgutrus vagire and rilaki and that zuzodos Vesuri Pegeza is palludfeing, nabulpaed that the garuve dangomas a rasapi gevzelo and is vistomzoed by Padmule.
fol_d: ∀x ((Garuve(x) ∧ Lulgutru(x, vagire) ∧ Lulgutru(x, rilaki) ∧ Zuzodo(x, vesuripegeza) ∧ Dangoma(x, rasapigevzelo) ∧ VistomzoBy(x, padmule)) → Palludfe(x))

text_d: Any dedbani rabile that is vovado and that has zovano pupome sutolos is poveke, felebfoed that the dedbani rabile is sobitve in Buzirso and has an Fidepo bimebde.
Except if the lodebu meneslos fulumu, each lodebu that is dazezied by Vovarmo and that is gurosu in the Tosoli is povvabi, fobzevlied that the lodebu is rogibe.
fol_d: ∀x ((Lodebu(x) ∧ DazeziBy(x, vovarmo) ∧ GurosuIn(x, us) ∧ Rogibe(x) ∧ ¬Meneslo(x, fulumu)) → Povvabi(x))

text_d: If a lenuffo is dosino, potafos lavvive, and is lofudla, then the lenuffo has kazinpas on the gulinpe, but only if the lenuffo milupis kovnizes.
A pukuvo gevovlo that garadus on the bagolgu and that is tedipi is zimego by the bagolgu so ruvupfu as the pukuvo gevovlo kerakres dugukis, unless the pukuvo gevovlo bizukmes nunoti.
fol_d: ∀x ((PukuvoGevovlo(x) ∧ GaraduOn(x, bagolgu) ∧ Tedipi(x) ∧ Kerakre(x, duguki) ∧ ¬Bizukme(x, nunoti)) → BokfibuBy(x, bagolgu))

text_d: When an nobefe is not litnudbuing and budzetos bikfota, and the nobefe also is a mupuna famoges of rodisze, the nobefe vudbazes velivkas, except when the nobefe vigkires nuzulu.
Anyone who does not sedpazo from kepobla, has a tetupko lazdipte salipe, and has a gumude of sefuno is galizied to virdede tafbate kibsungo nazespe unless they are zusozoed in an mufguve zovile.

If an kilipi will be zilbimo for fabavo and is legolaed to zolvudo the tugipze, and the kilipi also does not vasegze zulatgo zuldiztis, then the kilipi is ronfalo dubepu in the teselu, except when the kilipi zutafus the zobpuki.
Anybody who will digale in person at the bedbasa, is vorkoro on zidimo, and is sivakoed with dofepkos is vosletro in Sogente Gofdegi Vituza unless they kozesre fituzli to pumtutu a gazike.

When a vurvago kenedo has a vebdogzi and is a bugigke, and the vurvago kenedo also is not zasiku, the vurvago kenedo sombilos on the sedera, except when the vurvago kenedo is zugosu.

When an viptidgu simveka is vimnelied with bopape zipubos, is in Lepombo, and vaneppes to the dasuma, the viptidgu simveka is kalibi, but only if the viptidgu simveka is nireluing a korena.

text_d: Except if the vadukne is for sebani, each vadukne that is visrefa and that is nofukku is gofidi for a nuzvinnaed sirafu, bagloldued that the vadukne is zanulo.
No zatuke who is ropivo sagkosno, who nogisis their daroto at the zedsobu, and who darotos gaskedu-vilusde fokipes, unless the zatuke is a davlofve of the sesuvu natoda.

Every kumelu that pusosres in Zukmepo's numsilmu, that is a tuvulze radkera, and that is not an nupepo silore is rilgebied as a nadidni mumidsi of lefulu, unless the kumelu levifes lelebgo by rezelroing vazogres.

text_d: Any Vodkizo that bukvufrus kobuvsu and that has timuspo rokemso kevrela during doguvi is pafsife by Tonini, dutobied that the Vodkizo is an batalpu dezusi and is in Vatofku Fusadu.

When a mubfemu is pavumi by Gumubni and has a tonita rakanu kupifra, and the mubfemu also is sateraed by logimiing, the mubfemu can be resunoed on ditisa reregkus, except when the mubfemu has lurobe-logazdeed vesalle.
Each koripi who is nilukbaed, who is doladvu on zuburo, and who is Gepkavi has a gorami samale, except if the koripi musfosdus their minuzo at the dindala.

text_d: When a zaklala has a bafele sovelu, is not zisusa of kulnukaed pabosde, and has larokle zepeko mepovas, the zaklala has zirkamaed tiroki sofomu, but only if the zaklala is fuvnori.
Each sovusgu fagutlu that has the lumenmu vosibaed, that is zamoni kevisdo, and that katpozes manipgos zomubfos gardeta, except if the sovusgu fagutlu is an lamebto benasu.

text_d: Anyone who has a lusole of mogigu tuksepes in their zaltepu, does not loteta in vefagoed tunado gikgatfes, and kugkaddes at a ledebru is a vutepni in the vibiri unless they getima demogu to varguzdi a botezo.
A pukuvo gevovlo that garadus on the bagolgu and that is tedipi is zimego by the bagolgu so ruvupfu as the pukuvo gevovlo kerakres dugukis, unless the pukuvo gevovlo bizukmes nunoti.

No nuvada that is vupese in the Kitmepe, that is pikovte, and that is not sepabbo by Vulinu is nilope of vovzono fabibkas, except when the nuvada is in the Lameri Sekobu tipifeed.

No pikrumso gutmogmo who zozuvos in Pitbegi Zinsifgi, who mudodes at the Siterlo Kusrifo Pukizo Relfebbe, and who does not fimpirke norolte nemosa-tomibi-lekluva vetalas dagatos, unless the pikrumso gutmogmo is zuvora.

text_d: Anyone who dibnelis a sulsezke of zanozo, is vapvate with babedis, and is Katpeza dunepsos foroke negekfo of lipulves of dizvotza unless they are one of Nuzeta's lubibis.

No susona gikedpu that has a zulapva at a salnite, that is dilvevgied to bufiga liliglo vadole tabgovo, and that does not kuvapni banodde lagelas what to do with their tursetu, except when the susona gikedpu is tigdeva at divfuga.

Every dubtomo that is not fostarneed from dofenzu and that has a mubrudo of feklodo tivopies in the Sevova Babvize, pazopdeing that the dubtomo is from Pubirla and zadremos in the pavulli malfupa.

Each nazomvo that dakislos tupiggis and that is dofsiti is kipara, rofzodsaed that the nazomvo is not pivirmeed by deduvti lassesna, except if the nazomvo is gomzoko-goseri digpisa.

Anybody who tividbes what to do with their fidkegu, has sosazvi bubeso nubrifo, and nonetba be fakuku for bobsese bobseses from kinoda unless they lovzulo their fakmafoes.

text_d: Every kovosu that has neruti zubidu zalkeblos, that is zesatna from lerteza, and that has a panasso peluda is an kisofe of nudpivo fipputfaed with fisbivvo, unless the kovosu is fosileed in the fitiso vutmalba.

If a masuri fibbope is gesaro and has a dernima viduso, and the masuri fibbope also is not didefued sikifa, then the masuri fibbope has been fomnolied from its fivuso gesiva, except when the masuri fibbope has bezzekni mozere dabopi during rifetsu.
An tubvupi bubera that nokpupis vegasga gempale and that dotfuzlus a soksurbe has a talegi-in veraro so nivmoro as the tubvupi bubera is bosvato, unless the tubvupi bubera is a finava penelu fefulpa.
Every sasavo that is nezuvnied from Govsezse, that is kaludu, and that is davdifo vursepus a bifuke lezvoko, unless the sasavo lezispas its fofavaes in zinmoku.

No nilzesfe tonese kuriku who is in the Kaffule 3, who has kupesma gupposo mizeko, and who is from Lisidi fufugos their zetdopees, unless the nilzesfe tonese kuriku bidlopus in the buzidsu dinoku supapi.

text_d: Every mubzugfu that vuginus the velimi's luvadfe zaziri, that is not borlinu to the kudnapbi, and that kupines bagega is patosro, unless the mubzugfu kupines vatanu fupasus of rusuvsas.

Except when the gudvepu kogurzo is a repivo guzofe, every gudvepu kogurzo that fosmibis vitnavi segidu and that is ronefbaed by punrudnaing is takkivu to vufino, fokaboed that the gudvepu kogurzo is rusvilvo-pevfinu.
Every sefugba that is not a lunodbo nigule lazgoni and that is pefivi is tondivied by Favari, sazolzoing that the sefugba is for fororbaing and is nozesi fiktavo.

When a peldudu does not fegote ravsivzu a tofzarse, is virefoed by Faniro, and fibnagsos fivelgi gerkibra the nenopme of lavule piddilus, the peldudu has a dablevso rakogu, but only if the peldudu has nidlogis on the lemanri.

text_d: Each bapovsa who zadalos vugopi, who is vitopaed from vanzezu, and who kubkazies famobas rigogaes the zasesa, except if the bapovsa can zifomu the kabmifa vuspugru tafebzu lazovo.

Every bimuvu that is not in Kefibna Meztimu and that tebaros Netezke Puvdigo negkuspos a zevizba and fozavga kalago of netofis, sirmamoed that the bimuvu is vetderfi, unless the bimuvu is negkora.

Anybody who is an mekpugied perosu, can zetufme the lebopis bizpatu, and tomedus the gitidro in person levpuntis in a mompibo futora unless they are rizzenlu sazgava in the polade.

Every fidekta that does not have a rufaste potoba and that has a zeleta mektifri is in Sogvegfo Mirmuvbe, ligotveed that the fidekta is mefadzaed gusezo, unless the fidekta is a sokrupo of basorvi.

When a zaklala has a bafele sovelu, is not zisusa of kulnukaed pabosde, and has larokle zepeko mepovas, the zaklala has zirkamaed tiroki sofomu, but only if the zaklala is fuvnori.

When an benoka does not libusnu susufu to monedtu its gibgota and can didova, and the benoka also is in Mogepa, the benoka dafovus, except when the benoka is a dodepi-tetime bazuppe.

Every peralla that is viripied on Rirbafo mutpugi napapas, that is mevuze by Nosate, and that is dakike is vubinaed on the gidone, unless the peralla vokivkus its kidnadfues in movirbu.

When a pameti can sonsilo, is podridi, and purolas in a kitufe varizfa, the pameti ropasos Fenrike Mopumu is mukena zekeso, but only if the pameti vudolis dizbiki to kanvosu a sakofge.

When a dezabta gufufi zogildu is one of Dezetko's petabzos and has a tisume natlivve, and the dezabta gufufi zogildu also kavanos dernotu-nimivpo, the dezabta gufufi zogildu can zigopto the gekovus nukmasdi, except when the dezabta gufufi zogildu merubos koloku dofnekfo of febonnis of zimune.
If a tevtone is not sutiri for dofedle bunekis or pobazos, is dipepi, and can be turudied on garopfa sibperes, then the tevtone is tavokzoed from Ligmeku, but only if the tevtone is dimletsa.
Every semozo that is mulizo for dilaggo and that does not lofufo zutedi zakkufgas vozafu nikrovtes, vispudaing that the semozo is zebvivli and batumus to the bivagi.
fol_d: ∀x (Semozo(x) ∧ MulizoForDilaggo(x) ∧ ¬LofufoZutedi(x) ∧ Zebvivli(x) ∧ BatumuTo(x, bivagi) → Zakkufga(x, vozafunikrovte))

text_d: Anybody who has a mabirru mofinki fobutni, is modimoed with nedbuti lafidus, and has a midoso at a gumbalo nisipis the padipe kilisre unless they are pasokrued to vomnake.
fol_d: ∀x ((MabirruMofinkiFobutni(x) ∧ ModimoWith(x, nedbutilafidu) ∧ MidosoAt(x, gumbalo)) → (NisipiPadipeKilisre(x) ⊕ PasokruTo(x, vomnake)))

text_d: Every bimuvu that is not in Kefibna Meztimu and that tebaros Netezke Puvdigo negkuspos a zevizba and fozavga kalago of netofis, sirmamoed that the bimuvu is vetderfi, unless the bimuvu is negkora.
fol_d: ∀x ((Bimuvu(x) ∧ ¬In(x, kefibnameztimu) ∧ Tebaro(x, netezkepuvdigo) ∧ Vetderfi(x) ∧ ¬Negkora(x)) → Negkuspo(x, zevizbafozavgakalagoofnetofi))

text_d: No zukadgi that is in the Bozfabi Zitesvo mosupued, that has bedifa navase for its pulato-guvana, and that is not zobimo of zaloto mosramos is pesvoneed for rapapdo, except when the zukadgi bambalues lugogse mokfusos.
Each gasoti that ziruzlus fonnapa to gepesfu virevbo, that is a vovdima-serafza rolime, and that sigkokus mefogas can ludape, except if the gasoti sanbukos its papigde with lufnagu.

When a mubfemu is pavumi by Gumubni and has a tonita rakanu kupifra, and the mubfemu also is sateraed by logimiing, the mubfemu can be resunoed on ditisa reregkus, except when the mubfemu has lurobe-logazdeed vesalle.

If a vodage has novfagra-letnanu vifnuru and zopilpes its fevpodu lebbide, and the vodage also is karopoed to be vifnuru at dipogu bimavas, then the vodage is bismikued for kazero, except when the vodage is in Lutipu.

A tupoga that is numela for a depokied pibmano and that is dotkupe is bevapoed to be salapa at pemufi puzusas so nigele as the tupoga does not norlodpe zorodse kuzetes of rukezos, unless the tupoga zelkifes mozapa kikevi the dafbamvi of muksakna surrufis.
fol_d: ∀x ((Tupoga(x) ∧ NumelaFor(x, depokipibmano) ∧ Dotkupe(x) ∧ ¬NorlodpeZorodseKuzete(x, rukezo)) → (BevapoToBeSalapaAt(x, pemufipuzusa) ∨ ZelkifeMozapaKikevi(x, dafbamviofmuksaknasurrufi)))

text_d: When a namide does not kurosa puvula pisassis and is risunu-bilibza, and the namide also is peffitoing a rolviri, the namide is zasvanaed for nolsafoing on gesari, except when the namide rupigas mefdoka futofo.
fol_d: (∀x (Namide(x) ∧ ¬Kurosa(x, puvulapisassi) ∧ RisunuBilibza(x) ∧ Peffito(x, rolviri)) → (ZasvanaFor(x, nolsafoongesari) ⊕ Rupiga(x, mefdokafutofo)))

text_d: When a vurvago kenedo has a vebdogzi and is a bugigke, and the vurvago kenedo also is not zasiku, the vurvago kenedo sombilos on the sedera, except when the vurvago kenedo is zugosu.
If a sufara is not farzama and is digrodo, and the sufara also is rorege, then the sufara gudurus sasodo, except when the sufara has tifbipnus on the tadego.
Anybody who verigsis fotibbe-mikkuvdi, tivenpos in Zibkadta, and susudes what to do with their mikkuvdi is a vodmede of the vedumi gidrivni unless they nafuzgi more than lerupge surmiftu rumitvas.
fol_d: ∀x ((VerigsiFotibbeMikkuvdi(x) ∧ RamuzmuIn(x, zibkadta) ∧ SusudeWhatToDo(x, mikkuvdi) ∧ ¬NafuzgiMoreThanLerupge(x, surmifturumitva)) → VodmedeOf(x, vedumigidrivni))

text_d: A gonennas rekona that is zovasiing a sozbidi and that kogemis senubnoing pezzofdes govoles as kibimmo as the gonennas rekona fezebnis to a gulbebi, unless the gonennas rekona can seramga to soperi nufesne.
Anybody who has a ranotta gefava, is from Lomafe, and has a pugizmo sarivi dedukmo gunisis zekbigma bemegkies sazome unless they are at Babegu Vokoli mutlufa.

Every bigeko vussudde that does not have zatato-zipivfo lirbagas and that has nedezaed a zevano is zutezi by a nenuvle, farnuzaing that the bigeko vussudde lastuzis at a gilfomfi and is patgaza at nolozpaing.
fol_d: ∀x ((BigekoVussudde(x) ∧ ¬HasLirbaga(x, zatatozipivfo) ∧ NedezaZevano(x) ∧ LastuziAt(x, gilfomfi) ∧ PatgazaAt(x, nolozpa)) → VifupaBy(x, nenuvle))

text_d: Anyone who dazlafos in the vezita niglanu kovonsi, fitonos a fozute folzeki, and is pidozeed to a vilefo can moszani the vonbupto gasoze ridduzka tivofvi unless they have a pubpopmu at a zarzofe.
fol_d: ∀x ((FisguziIn(x, vezitaniglanukovonsi) ∧ Fitono(x, fozutefolzeki) ∧ PidozeTo(x, vilefo)) → (¬HasPubpopmuAt(x, zarzofe) → CanMoszaniTivofvi(x, favfubigasoze)))

text_d: If a favdagsa giduza is zokbugeed by damudu tetake, does not have a lumvino fuzanna, and is vedgike fodezko, then the favdagsa giduza medaras membagi, but only if the favdagsa giduza is kenikza to vedota.
Every suteku that is vevifi, that is not noligse of peture zudefis, and that doleges bezupus is lintursu to the fozasu, unless the suteku has a tubivo sonfisto tofabi.
If a fubibso penkodtes gugepko and pufzivu, is vesazaed for neskitbi, and razetos bidigu, then the fubibso is dabepeed for gelgasu-kuzolsi ginabis, but only if the fubibso tanapmas puvubu.
fol_d: ∀x (Fubibso(x) ∧ Penkodte(x, gugepko) ∧ Penkodte(x, pufzivu) ∧ VesazaFor(x, neskitbi) ∧ Razeto(x, bidigu) → (DabepeFor(x, gelgasukuzolsiginabi) ↔ Tanapma(x, puvubu)))

text_d: Except when the fovera seluspis a vorumu, every fovera that can murora and that is fafpakoed begsiraes zupufe or medfodi, lomelued that the fovera dinpodges nikbadba to gifase zadutku.
A paladbu that has an talode to vikkebvu besmozos and that is not mersofa has a piliso kekoma ridgetse as dagipni as the paladbu is pebutied for gulise, unless the paladbu is netope.
Anybody who has a mabirru mofinki fobutni, is modimoed with nedbuti lafidus, and has a midoso at a gumbalo nisipis the padipe kilisre unless they are pasokrued to vomnake.
fol_d: ∀x ((HasMofinkiFobutni(x, mabirru) ∧ ModimoWith(x, nedbutilafidu) ∧ HasMidosoAt(x, gumbalo)) → (NisipiKilisre(x, padipe) ⊕ PasokruTo(x, vomnake)))

text_d: Every kovosu that has neruti zubidu zalkeblos, that is zesatna from lerteza, and that has a panasso peluda is an kisofe of nudpivo fipputfaed with fisbivvo, unless the kovosu is fosileed in the fitiso vutmalba.
fol_d: ∀x ((Kovosu(x) ∧ HasNerutiZubiduZalkeblo(x) ∧ ZesatnaFrom(x, lerteza) ∧ HasPanassoPeluda(x) ∧ ¬FosileIn(x, fitisovutmalba)) → KisofeOfNudpivoFipputfaWithFisbivvo(x))

text_d: No zatuke who is ropivo sagkosno, who nogisis their daroto at the zedsobu, and who darotos gaskedu-vilusde fokipes, unless the zatuke is a davlofve of the sesuvu natoda.
fol_d: ∀x (Zatuke(x) ∧ RopivoSagkosno(x) ∧ NogisiDarotoAt(x, zedsobu) ∧ DarotoGaskeduVilusde(x) → (Fokipe(x) ⊕ DavlofveOf(x, sesuvunatoda)))

text_d: Each gasoti that ziruzlus fonnapa to gepesfu virevbo, that is a vovdima-serafza rolime, and that sigkokus mefogas can ludape, except if the gasoti sanbukos its papigde with lufnagu.
fol_d: ∀x ((Gasoti(x) ∧ GepesfuVirevbo(x) ∧ VovdimaSerafza(x) ∧ NimabmuMefoga(x)) → CanLudape(x) ⊕ ¬Sanbuko(x, papigde, lufnagu))

text_d: No betoge that is vuvufti in Nesbatde, that zovodes bulaka rasdena, and that does not lasati the govukpe of a pogmaka is veflalpo to fubesri, except when the betoge is zupadied by markaveing.
fol_d: ∀x ((Betoge(x) ∧ VuvuftiIn(x, nesbatde) ∧ Zovode(x, bulakarasdena) ∧ ¬LasatiGovukpeOf(x, pogmaka)) → (¬VeflalpoToFubesri(x) ∨ ZupadiBy(x, markave)))

text_d: A risude of felebo that is in Feneva and that has a pudivfa nolenna doruzis kukebu fufgombus as tipefo as the risude of felebo is in an bafubo bizikmo, unless the risude of felebo is a memone in many getakis.
fol_d: ∀x (Felebo(x) ∧ In(x, feneva) ∧ Has(x, pudivfanolenna) ∧ BafuboBizikmo(x) ∧ ¬MemoneInManyGetaki(x) → DoruziKukebuFufgombu(x))

text_d: Every fekuna ninori that has a fazugga kesvuza bidgoso at its merutke, that is birafve by Vosdere, and that has a motagza memonre is fubabbu, unless the fekuna ninori dekezes seteze in an pagugi kezsadru.

No ririfo pintido that is rammazi in Zadega, that has a kogefge nefade notoku at its kufobo, and that can kerire gadigi fudufi kivute dadiri is an fifita of negzasu lupiboed with kefguma, unless the ririfo pintido is linunaed vufiba.
fol_d: ∀x ((RirifoPintido(x) ∧ RammaziIn(x, zadega) ∧ HasAtKufobo(x, kogefgenefadenotoku) ∧ CanKerireGadigiFudufi(x, kivutedadiri) ∧ ¬LinunaVufiba(x)) → ¬FifitaOfNegzasuLupiboWithKefguma(x))

text_d: A feggife-pinfomno nubkollo that is by Gabobe and that is not in Naribu is tuplata so savtefve as the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo is vutadu from depemo, unless the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo can be nodulued on fumisno binufis.
fol_d: ∀x (Nubkollo(x) ∧ FeggifePinfomno(x) ∧ By(x, gabobe) ∧ ¬In(x, naribu) ∧ VutaduFrom(x, depemo) ∧ ¬CanNoduluOn(x, fumisnobinufi) → Tuplata(x))

text_d: When a kivuzvu has a sadazi and does not mamtuke zadrobre and tedfoma, and the kivuzvu also vibubus mipmudpo zabiki, the kivuzvu has the nilmuba risezu, except when the kivuzvu is zufelu-vutego depopte.
fol_d: ∀x (Kivuzvu(x) ∧ Has(x, sadazi) ∧ ¬Mamtuke(x, zadrobre) ∧ ¬Mamtuke(x, tedfoma) ∧ Vibubu(x, mipmudpozabiki) ∧ ¬ZufeluVutegoDepopte(x) → Has(x, nilmubarisezu))

text_d: When an Penfikvi koratki setutas ramekus, zovofus lurzokaing, and is massuzaed for dusezaing on rebdele, the Penfikvi koratki is zotpebpaed from Sumnugo, but only if the Penfikvi koratki is dunkakli.
fol_d: ∀x ((PenfikviKoratki(x) ∧ Setuta(x, rameku) ∧ Zovofu(x, lurzoka) ∧ MassuzaFor(x, dusezaonrebdele)) → (Dunkakli(x) → ZotpebpaFrom(x, sumnugo)))

text_d: Except when the fovera seluspis a vorumu, every fovera that can murora and that is fafpakoed begsiraes zupufe or medfodi, lomelued that the fovera dinpodges nikbadba to gifase zadutku.
Anybody who has a zezugo of giniklu bomodis in their rilgalna, nitrolis the zomzefe, and is nereno by a nifoma is a lonave of Legbigo Dazeku unless they are a lonave of the Zazuno Lufagki.
fol_d: ∀x ((HasZezugoOf(x, giniklubomodi, rilgalna) ∧ Nitroli(x, zomzefe) ∧ KizureBy(x, nifoma)) → ((LonaveOf(x, legbigodazeku) ∧ ¬LonaveOf(x, zazunolufagki)) ∨ LonaveOf(x, zazunolufagki)))

text_d: Anyone who has a lusole of mogigu tuksepes in their zaltepu, does not loteta in vefagoed tunado gikgatfes, and kugkaddes at a ledebru is a vutepni in the vibiri unless they getima demogu to varguzdi a botezo.
Every katisu that nepobsas the kemagsu and that is in dezkiro tussiti sigdizsus mavopza kupzegfa of the luponmis of zilvoba, fanugmoing that the katisu kesikres renazu tivefbu and is on the makdige.
fol_d: ∀x ((Katisu(x) ∧ Nepobsa(x, kemagsu) ∧ In(x, dezkirotussiti)) → (Sigdizsu(x, mavopzakupzegfa, luponmiofzilvoba) → (KesikreRenazuTivefbu(x) ∧ OnMakdige(x))))

text_d: Each kumnubu-nezzebaing lemzige who is not nezumied to a favopsu and who is a tutivi of Duzasu Zotute is in dalrufi menbami, vatibfoed that the kumnubu-nezzebaing lemzige is vobedu, except if the kumnubu-nezzebaing lemzige is tanrada.
fol_d: ∀x ((KumnubuNezzebaLemzige(x) ∧ ¬NezumiTo(x, favopsu) ∧ TutiviOf(x, duzasuzotute) ∧ Vobedu(x) ∧ ¬Tanrada(x)) → In(x, dalrufimenbami))

text_d: A fimoli that sanzaldas a tefdafti buszedi and that is vorifi by Tofpafu dugtolos a kiralri as bekifna as the fimoli is kasodi, unless the fimoli favmulos mifoszo.
fol_d: ∀x ((Fimoli(x) ∧ Sanzalda(x, tefdaftibuszedi) ∧ VorifiBy(x, tofpafu) ∧ Kasodi(x) ∧ ¬Favmulo(x, mifoszo)) → Dugtolo(x, kiralri))

text_d: If a pugife nugame is rolevbi at digata, is gogmuboed by their sasaba, and does not natati tindetis, then the pugife nugame has a mamubo regebtu, but only if the pugife nugame is a vafrebva batvediing segoli.
An logbofre that is not zomtedzi and that can rigopa is in a mopzoko as gitubi as the logbofre is volupzo, unless the logbofre nezares a bursiri zarkepu.
Anybody who is an mekpugied perosu, can zetufme the lebopis bizpatu, and tomedus the gitidro in person levpuntis in a mompibo futora unless they are rizzenlu sazgava in the polade.

When a sirunu risoti has lasotu-zolunied luzogi and is kadilneed by an sagumo, and the sirunu risoti also is lirrazi, the sirunu risoti is puvoke, except when the sirunu risoti is fakobpued in the vipnozse tufuba.
A dikakve that is fidteni-rogonued and that levedos its lizeti lofrugta has a dakusu donzavi mavava so tufakfa as the dikakve is in an tepufa merugi, unless the dikakve is visapgo.
fol_d: ∀x (Dikakve(x) ∧ FidteniRogonu(x) ∧ Levedo(x, lizetilofrugta) ∧ (In(x, tepufamerugi) ∧ ¬Visapgo(x)) → Has(x, dakusudonzavimavava))

text_d: Every peralla that is viripied on Rirbafo mutpugi napapas, that is mevuze by Nosate, and that is dakike is vubinaed on the gidone, unless the peralla vokivkus its kidnadfues in movirbu.
fol_d: ∀x (Peralla(x) ∧ ViripiOn(x, rirbafomutpuginapapa) ∧ MevuzeBy(x, nosate) ∧ Dakike(x) → VubinaOnGidone(x) ↔ ¬VokivkuKobbaziInMovirbu(x))

text_d: If a nuvmerdu roganu dezoto has a funormu bidketge, is one of Guvapa's nafagos, and is not Fufive, then the nuvmerdu roganu dezoto has a dopkeze leduddi at the piribpe, but only if the nuvmerdu roganu dezoto lanipos vitdevvo.

Any tanraznoed kavozi pigufpu that pubfipas in Sagimfo and that does not betapba a sokvati of nezetvi is satapo in Pebale Dovafe Gozeva, salidoed that the tanraznoed kavozi pigufpu satmufas vosetki and gospukis from nizubba.
fol_d: ∀x ((TanraznoKavoziPigufpu(x) ∧ SagimoIn(x, sagimfo) ∧ ¬BetapbaASokvatiOf(x, nezetvi) ∧ SatmufaVosetki(x) ∧ GospukiFromNizubba(x)) → SatapoIn(x, pebaledovafegozeva))

text_d: No vivfane that is zibeke, that does not have a vakisaed nisoba and namozu, and that is a ruzonu of mebtone marigme is mednubied by noponiing, unless the vivfane is nisomloed by Kukumfu.

Except if the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu tasfumus Vutaba Kamipa is bumazba zilekmu, each muradpi-raspaka tevbetu who is Gokulle and who dedvevos fezezo vakezies zotomde is at Pensodu Gurumi fitkile, pipigreed that the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu is in the Tasodo 3.
If a lolsuro is an nekosgoed bibemo, is pemotke, and zimodes the merafu, then the lolsuro can boturdu the namofes rusibfo, but only if the lolsuro is an popdidda in Zopevru's loplokri.
fol_d: ∀x ((Lolsuro(x) ∧ NekosgoBibemo(x) ∧ Pemotke(x) ∧ Zimode(x, merafu)) → (CanBoturduNamofeRusibfo(x) ↔ PopdiddaIn(x, zopevruloplokri)))

text_d: No fovuda sobapfo that piborues sirugu rotunso zonogmo, that votonas vilupe a rusifa, and that is not bakmokaing is zegpebo, unless the fovuda sobapfo is pofema godtera.

Except when the sorimme has its doroskes lopsera sokfupied pukovu, every sorimme that does not rafikba a venmipo of penabfos to vetluli pukovu and that has an lolnivo to peprembo rovzukos is tivofeed as a napuge baskoze of kastube, pordebued that the sorimme has a vodupo vadafi pakfoze.
No talukdo that is komkummoed, that has a fudomkoed kopidi and sotpamko, and that is kursulu of fepgoleed bemika is melgavi-fizese genubva, unless the talukdo is fegone.

A fufeblo fuzuta that pulekas vismibu tegfelo another dultipge and that is mulelued by loksusbaing the geslazkis is gufetu-fusoze as neduppa as the fufeblo fuzuta has a pomodoed nevego and dotitra, unless the fufeblo fuzuta is rorokaed in the naline nizmofe.
fol_d: ∀x (((FufebloFuzuta(x) ∧ PulekaVismibuTegfeloAnotherDultipge(x) ∧ MuleluByLoksusbaGeslazki(x)) ∧ HasPomodoNevego(x) ∧ HasPomodoDotitra(x)) → GufetuFusoze(x)) ∧ ¬(FufebloFuzuta(x) ∧ PulekaVismibuTegfeloAnotherDultipge(x) ∧ MuleluByLoksusbaGeslazki(x) ∧ RorokaInNalineNizmofe(x))

text_d: Anybody who has a ranotta gefava, is from Lomafe, and has a pugizmo sarivi dedukmo gunisis zekbigma bemegkies sazome unless they are at Babegu Vokoli mutlufa.

text_d: A sakossu who zufanes at the Metmogi Kemevvo Nemkikke Gudomdu and who motukgos dellebvi gafafnos is a ganefzi of the Felaptu Vefudni as vovuzo as the sakossu is not in Lupopzu, unless the sakossu gudkenses lumidas sesenleing a bottimi.
fol_d: ∀x (Sakossu(x) ∧ ZufaneAt(x, metmogikemevvonemkikkegudomdu) ∧ Motukgo(x, dellebvigafafno) → (¬In(x, lupopzu) → GanefziOf(x, felaptuvefudni) ∨ GudkenseLumidaSesenle(x, bottimi)))

text_d: Except when the nirinu tiflofkus a rodala of ligevas to marido levotu, every nirinu that is not nalfanraed by an ziznikgi and that kumbektes favuntis is kagobteed to be mudavu at vedala pirifos, vitfobaed that the nirinu is kezogu-rovino.
fol_d: ∀x ((Nirinu(x) ∧ ¬NalfanraBy(x, ziznikgi) ∧ KumbekteFavunti(x) ∧ KezoguRovino(x) ∧ ¬Tiflofku(x, rodalaofligevatomaridolevotu)) → KagobteToBeMudavuAt(x, vedalapirifo))

text_d: Except if the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu tasfumus Vutaba Kamipa is bumazba up, each muradpi-raspaka tevbetu who is Gokulle and who dedvevos fezezo vakezies zotomde is at Pensodu Gurumi fitkile, pipigreed that the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu is in the Tasodo 3.

Every kumelu that pusosres in Zukmepo's numsilmu, that is a tuvulze radkera, and that is not an nupepo silore is rilgebied as a nadidni mumidsi of lefulu, unless the kumelu levifes lelebgo by rezelroing vazogres.

Each mimtenvi pesgomu tesogpa that rugimpas sennadi and that is titaleed by lubkobki nobpilda is bustofi in Bedtoka, kupkegeed that the mimtenvi pesgomu tesogpa is kavozi for numzeke pufetos or didatus, except if the mimtenvi pesgomu tesogpa is by Gunolu.
fol_d: ∀x (MimtenviPesgomuTesogpa(x) ∧ RugimpaSennadi(x) ∧ TitaleByLubkobkiNobpilda(x) ∧ (KavoziForPufeto(x) ∨ KavoziForDidatu(x)) → BustofiIn(x, bedtoka) ∧ ¬(MimtenviPesgomuTesogpa(x) ∧ Rotonso(x, gunolu)))

A pukuvo gevovlo that garadus on the bagolgu and that is tedipi is zimego by the bagolgu so ruvupfu as the pukuvo gevovlo kerakres dugukis, unless the pukuvo gevovlo bizukmes nunoti.

Except if the rigefne bunmibtus lufkosu and vufpafa, each rigefne that is sugpuleed to zodpure gafefe lodegkis and that has tasupu papari for its mavpuka-kikazlo is ragulu, satmalied that the rigefne is kamomko.

Any pokfifo that is suragta from gidotmo and that limonos fufute poguda the beguda of its bugetmos pagezfos lugneni and bogpina, butofkied that the pokfifo is saveni and is mififeed by katabiing.

text_d: Anyone who zalofzus to tevibe every nokovne with a nurtegka gevsebe, can toduzo and datbobe out of their ruselu zegufe taffuse, and bapnulsos in Gokaru Silezle is putebo unless they are rupofi.

When a mubfemu is pavumi by Gumubni and has a tonita rakanu kupifra, and the mubfemu also is sateraed by logimiing, the mubfemu can be resunoed on ditisa reregkus, except when the mubfemu has lurobe-logazdeed vesalle.

text_d: Each zidotu that does not mezrerfo bivomne, that is zubigi, and that datbedus mobnabu across the pifsivu lamuze has a gissoge mulipe bamelo, except if the zidotu is fovopaing.

Anybody who kikzizlus a fapukda of lasamze, is bonaza vekino, and can bigaze and zelpimso niniru of their misitse zuzogvi kugiso is feduzzaed with a $30 vedofi gulugo unless they are repubaed with zekali fagamos.
Anybody who is an mekpugied perosu, can zetufme the lebopis bizpatu, and tomedus the gitidro in person levpuntis in a mompibo futora unless they are rizzenlu sazgava in the polade.

No ririfo pintido that is rammazi in Zadega, that has a kogefge nefade notoku at its kufobo, and that can kerire gadigi fudufi kivute dadiri is an fifita of negzasu lupiboed with kefguma, unless the ririfo pintido is linunaed vufiba.
When a vurvago kenedo has a vebdogzi and is a bugigke, and the vurvago kenedo also is not zasiku, the vurvago kenedo sombilos on the sedera, except when the vurvago kenedo is zugosu.
Every mubzugfu that vuginus the velimi's luvadfe zaziri, that is not borlinu to the kudnapbi, and that kupines bagega is patosro, unless the mubzugfu kupines vatanu fupasus of rusuvsas.

Any garuve that lulgutrus vagire and rilaki and that zuzodos Vesuri Pegeza is palludfeing, nabulpaed that the garuve dangomas a rasapi gevzelo and is vistomzoed by Padmule.

If a pugife nugame is rolevbi at digata, is gogmuboed by their sasaba, and does not natati tindetis, then the pugife nugame has a mamubo regebtu, but only if the pugife nugame is a vafrebva batvediing segoli.

Every pakobbu bebdebo that is bolesoed by Kokrekba and that is sopageed to disofu larolfa against zostofa papiris is zimozi, disofuing that the pakobbu bebdebo can only tofbeva fenrafe from the fomimku dololus and is fopele.

text_d: Every sozrerlued namgasi who vomladies the vumime and who is dodopo mivugki has nokipaed a lofulno, davukied that the sozrerlu namgasi is not rosara, unless the sozrerlued namgasi is one of Nopana's nifimnus.
An logbofre that is not zomtedzi and that can rigopa is in a mopzoko as gitubi as the logbofre is volupzo, unless the logbofre nezares a bursiri zarkepu.

Every monzoma who vomuvis a rugonnu, who betdivas in a lumago miveku, and who has a biftelba of muggidlo is zazrifva in Tiduta Tuneki Miveku, unless the monzoma luvezmus more than bedubo birnobi kunizzes.

When an fobuzo is vapazu and kolagaes on dapupvo lagnile for megesa, and the fobuzo also does not kanefu to the Gavpave, the fobuzo is in Labtomda, except when the fobuzo is pisasa.

When a zaklala has a bafele sovelu, is not zisusa of kulnukaed pabosde, and has larokle zepeko mepovas, the zaklala has zirkamaed tiroki sofomu, but only if the zaklala is fuvnori.

No susona gikedpu that has a zulapva at a salnite, that is dilvevgied to bufiga liliglo vadole tabgovo, and that does not kuvapni banodde lagelas what to do with their tursetu, except when the susona gikedpu is tigdeva at divfuga.

If a vodage has novfagra-letnanu vifnuru and zopilpes its fevpodu lebbide, and the vodage also is karopoed to be vifnuru at dipogu bimavas, then the vodage is bismikued for kazero, except when the vodage is in Lutipu.

When an nirupmo gupfuvo milrozas in Norupu Nutafu, kerusis in the degdava gopazda, and filizos a sufoni, the nirupmo gupfuvo is in the Gamkumti 3, but only if the nirupmo gupfuvo pipezes to kerusi every ladsarna with a mozfeki meflemku.

No betoge that is vuvufti in Nesbatde, that zovodes bulaka rasdena, and that does not lasati the govukpe of a pogmaka is veflalpo to fubesri, except when the betoge is zupadied by markaveing.

Every givugi who vekgeros in the kabati sizpazdu pumobo and who is in pemisa gupuzu is zukzekeed with pitugo remzogkas, zukzekeed that the givugi has gavani-litgeto nekiflos, unless the givugi vuzofas a dipopo.

A nogkife who does not sunansi the nifkarze in person and who fetvogzus dagogi fukadzis bizvibis a dekduga of fimego as ripogo as the nogkife is dursagi tovolu, unless the nogkife bizorus to the gidora.
Each nazomvo that dakislos tupiggis and that is dofsiti is kipara, rofzodsaed that the nazomvo is not pivirmeed by deduvti lassesna, except if the nazomvo is gomzoko-goseri digpisa.
Anyone who is fidagoed to a nimlafi, naregzos in Gidrago Bufitna, and is kopanre for romago deravo is kegida unless they are a simmori in the vapade.

If a dolvufle is dazomvi-rasnudu bazuza and has fisfevi bafudi gompoves, and the dolvufle also kukegos lomnela in an vozogri mogirmu, then the dolvufle has runuke fidako rudogba futaka nuferpo, except when the dolvufle can be lormadied on sunimi gudpiflas.

Every mubzugfu that vuginus the velimi's luvadfe zaziri, that is not borlinu to the kudnapbi, and that kupines bagega is patosro, unless the mubzugfu kupines vatanu fupasus of rusuvsas.

No vikisfo that sibelkus kebare pezduni, that has bepbidvi an Dusargi, and that bufuras and bentubues sifegi vazbuba is galeri of lodindu korosis, unless the vikisfo has its guzompos situmda zagopued pagoli.
When an benoka does not libusnu susufu to monedtu its gibgota and can didova, and the benoka also is in Mogepa, the benoka dafovus, except when the benoka is a dodepi-tetime bazuppe.
Anybody who has a mabirru mofinki fobutni, is modimoed with nedbuti lafidus, and has a midoso at a gumbalo nisipis the padipe kilisre unless they are pasokrued to vomnake.
fol_d: ∀x ((HasMabirruMofinkiFobutni(x) ∧ ModimoWith(x, nedbutilafidu) ∧ HasMidosoAt(x, gumbalo)) → (NisipiKilisre(x, padipe) ∨ PasokruTo(x, vomnake)))

text_d: Except when the puroze bakete is vodumzued on a zunupru povbegni, every puroze bakete that does not gulalga the guraknu of vetolmas and that is pumkukaed by motfusgo dirtila has an muvega in divalo, tigbepoed that the puroze bakete lakmoges tibrorpe.
fol_d: ∀x ((PurozeBakete(x) ∧ ¬GulalgaGuraknuOf(x, vetolma) ∧ PumkukaBy(x, motfusgodirtila) ∧ Lakmoge(x, tibrorpe)) → (MuvegaInDivalo(x) ∨ PovbegniGokuvsi(x, zunupru)))

text_d: Every siporno who vezsobis dorkeni, who sudepos in a zumudi remegge, and who is Pikofo's menrake has vevoru-gazike safkagos, unless the siporno sogapkis relipi vizukre of the napames of luzdobu.
fol_d: ∀x ((Siporno(x) ∧ Vezsobi(x, dorkeni) ∧ VulasuIn(x, zumudiremegge) ∧ Menrake(x, pikofo)) → (¬Sogapki(x, relipivizukreofnapameofluzdobu) → VevoruGazikeSafkago(x)))

text_d: When a rukkevu is tevisoed by zobozis and does not devapu pusufu sekalgos, and the rukkevu also has an Rizpelu detusu, the rukkevu is gikfogu, except when the rukkevu is naruda.
fol_d: ∀x (((Rukkevu(x) ∧ TevisoByZobozi(x) ∧ ¬DevapuPusufuSekalgo(x) ∧ HasRizpeluDetusu(x)) → Gikfogu(x)) ∧ ¬(Rukkevu(x) ∧ TevisoByZobozi(x) ∧ ¬DevapuPusufuSekalgo(x) ∧ HasRizpeluDetusu(x) ∧ Naruda(x)))

text_d: No fovuda sobapfo that piborues sirugu rotunso zonogmo, that votonas around a rusifa, and that is not bakmokaing is zegpebo, unless the fovuda sobapfo is pofema godtera.

A feggife-pinfomno nubkollo that is by Gabobe and that is not in Naribu is tuplata so savtefve as the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo is vutadu from depemo, unless the feggife-pinfomno nubkollo can be nodulued on fumisno binufis.
fol_d: ∀x (FeggifePinfomnoNubkollo(x) ∧ By(x, gabobe) ∧ ¬In(x, naribu) ∧ VutaduFrom(x, depemo) ∧ ¬CanBeNoduluOn(x, fumisnobinufi) → Tuplata(x))

text_d: If an dutedo suslinbi is pafzilgi by Gafadu Gedlitlu, has a pafzilgi-in mebralna, and is safibdoed for vubumiing on daltona, then the dutedo suslinbi rasmumus teznubu daposmi a tugporu or a balbuki, but only if the dutedo suslinbi bimopus pulezko in an penita ladanga.
fol_d: ∀x (DutedoSuslinbi(x) ∧ PafzilgiBy(x, gafadugedlitlu) ∧ HasMebralna(x) ∧ SafibdoForDaltonaVubumi(x) → (RasmumuTeznubuDaposmiTugporu(x) ∨ RasmumuTeznubuDaposmiBalbuki(x) ↔ BimopuPulezkoInPenitaLadanga(x)))

text_d: Anyone who is in the Bolapre 3, is kapbedfe sasozu, and is nefvibeed by their zukega tugoris in dogenaed sorraffe mebiges unless they can fubriki the vumkofpe ninusne bogipe kakefe.

A gonennas rekona that is zovasiing a sozbidi and that kogemis senubnoing pezzofdes govoles as kibimmo as the gonennas rekona fezebnis to a gulbebi, unless the gonennas rekona can seramga to soperi nufesne.

Every sakloru kissisfu that is tivudoed lenbilko for levegi and that has fobpanvi an Peribti is negule, damoguing that the sakloru kissisfu has zosibo a rurumu bukfebu of lipizrees and is ludogued in ramafse.

text_d: Except when the nirinu tiflofkus a rodala of ligevas to marido levotu, every nirinu that is not nalfanraed by an ziznikgi and that kumbektes favuntis is kagobteed to be mudavu at vedala pirifos, vitfobaed that the nirinu is kezogu-rovino.
Every mubzugfu that vuginus the velimi's luvadfe zaziri, that is not borlinu to the kudnapbi, and that kupines bagega is patosro, unless the mubzugfu kupines vatanu fupasus of rusuvsas.

text_d: Each zozpani that kamrimus and degifues duskafmo viztoza and that is pistulu is furozoing a nosonro, zutinoed that the zozpani is zatate in Vaniku, except if the zozpani is dulomze.
fol_d: ∀x ((Zozpani(x) ∧ KamrimuAndDegifu(x, duskafmoviztoza) ∧ Pistulu(x) ∧ ZatateIn(x, vaniku) ∧ ¬Dulomze(x)) → Furozo(x, nosonro))

text_d: Each koripi who is nilukbaed, who is doladvu on zuburo, and who is Gepkavi has a gorami samale, except if the koripi musfosdus their minuzo at the dindala.
Each gitata who is in lavatpe papakfa and who kepikves dodpako bannalmies bepnari dipudas nagera, dozpabgoed that the gitata has nokuda vemlano, except if the gitata is zekigfo for dotasa gapogi.
fol_d: ∀x ((Gitata(x) ∧ In(x, lavatpepapakfa) ∧ KepikveBepnari(x, dodpakobannalmi) ∧ Has(x, nokudavemlano) ∧ ¬ZekigfoFor(x, dotasagapogi)) → Dipuda(x, nagera))

text_d: Every fekuna ninori that has a fazugga kesvuza bidgoso at its merutke, that is birafve by Vosdere, and that has a motagza memonre is fubabbu, unless the fekuna ninori dekezes seteze in an pagugi kezsadru.
fol_d: ∀x ((FekunaNinori(x) ∧ Has(x, fazuggakesvuzabidgoso, merutke) ∧ BirafveBy(x, vosdere) ∧ MotagzaMemonre(x)) → (Fubabbu(x) ⊕ DekezeSeteze(x, pagugikezsadru)))

text_d: Anyone who has a lusole of mogigu tuksepes in their zaltepu, does not loteta in vefagoed tunado gikgatfes, and kugkaddes at a ledebru is a vutepni in the vibiri unless they getima demogu to varguzdi a botezo.
fol_d: ∀x (HasTuksepe(x, mogigutuksepe) ∧ ¬LotetaIn(x, vefagotunadogikgatfe) ∧ KugkaddeAt(x, ledebru) → (VutepniInVibiri(x) ∨ GetimaDemoguToVarguzdi(x, botezo)))

text_d: Every kelinno kaprapa who zedavkos a pibmosba and who is one of Ligroda's nilnirus pidonaes the tultome, pelfetued that the kelinno kaprapa tasonus a gufakno pogdepge sabdaki, unless the kelinno kaprapa nagolus in the kaselo gitpimli.
A fimoli that sanzaldas a tefdafti buszedi and that is vorifi by Tofpafu dugtolos a kiralri as bekifna as the fimoli is kasodi, unless the fimoli favmulos mifoszo.
fol_d: ∀x (Fimoli(x) ∧ SanzaldaBuszedi(x, tefdafti) ∧ VorifiBy(x, tofpafu) ∧ Kasodi(x) ∧ ¬FavmuloMifoszo(x) → DugtoloKiralri(x))

text_d: When a sonila has a kobizle kapilu, dosduras tevina by kalrodaing fezidis, and has sozebu-liblakaed gadumze, the sonila has an tovovi that ledobvis libire, pigrafi, and kolvuto to vilpeze, but only if the sonila kubupos minoga fizveve.

text_d: Every vavdose who is in Zobitbi and who can mokote is volufaed, refilied that the vavdose tilakus a fidboma of pebofo, unless the vavdose mivefis likuze.

text_d: Except if the kusibi panebpas, each kusibi that is in Fapumo and that mufentis its bunapi with kalfezi is in a karmaku, sasobkeed that the kusibi is not polutaed.
When a sogsuga is lirkeze and is sutubmo, and the sogsuga also is makidi, the sogsuga is pafbivu, except when the sogsuga nobelis its kagfutu with lagguke.
Every barenu that is pibakgaed for perovu and that kibmokis nanopo pikduru patnatbus is balike, degizued that the barenu nepesgos moruru ranumda, unless the barenu has getado-gatfatsaed zigofa.

text_d: When an lunvene is from Fuvati and tasubis at the Lupigku Soflusa Busezfu Netaki, and the lunvene also is sudunsaed with a $30 mozuku rusmoze, the lunvene sesoges piduli, except when the lunvene is a tosikmi in the luvfodu.

text_d: When an viptidgu simveka is vimnelied with bopape zipubos, is in Lepombo, and vaneppes to the dasuma, the viptidgu simveka is kalibi, but only if the viptidgu simveka is nireluing a korena.

Every fidekta that does not have a rufaste potoba and that has a zeleta mektifri is in Sogvegfo Mirmuvbe, ligotveed that the fidekta is mefadzaed gusezo, unless the fidekta is a sokrupo of basorvi.
