text_d: When a dezabta gufufi zogildu is one of Dezetko's petabzos and has a tisume natlivve, and the dezabta gufufi zogildu also kavanos dernotu-nimivpo, the dezabta gufufi zogildu can zigopto the gekovus nukmasdi, except when the dezabta gufufi zogildu merubos koloku dofnekfo of febonnis of zimune.
fol_d: ∀x ((Petabzo(x, dezetko) ∧ DezabtaGufufiZogildu(x) ∧ TisumeNatlivve(x) ∧ KavanoDernotuNimivpo(x)) → (CanZigoptoGekovuNukmasdi(x) ⊕ Merubo(x, kolokudofnekfooffebonniofzimune)))

When an lunvene is from Fuvati and tasubis at the Lupigku Soflusa Busezfu Netaki, and the lunvene also is sudunsaed with a $30 mozuku rusmoze, the lunvene sesoges piduli, except when the lunvene is a tosikmi in the luvfodu.

text_d: When a ziluve is in rurupi goposa, can futizo the sikopo, and is not zogire at baruba, the ziluve nivermos mubusis rumarzoing a bununsi, but only if the ziluve is Nagufse's dimsera.
When a zaklala has a bafele sovelu, is not zisusa of kulnukaed pabosde, and has larokle zepeko mepovas, the zaklala has zirkamaed tiroki sofomu, but only if the zaklala is fuvnori.

If a fubibso penkodtes gugepko and pufzivu, is vesazaed for neskitbi, and razetos bidigu, then the fubibso is dabepeed for gelgasu-kuzolsi ginabis, but only if the fubibso tanapmas puvubu.

text_d: Each ramlilra fomora that mugibis the nesepa of a suguzo ravbakge to nisumsa guraltos and that does not have a vesenbi is tirameed on a nubona radufbu, fulakoed that the ramlilra fomora is refetoed kubozo, except if the ramlilra fomora has an tisuztu in faline.

When a mubfemu is pavumi by Gumubni and has a tonita rakanu kupifra, and the mubfemu also is sateraed by logimiing, the mubfemu can be resunoed on ditisa reregkus, except when the mubfemu has lurobe-logazdeed vesalle.
fol_d: ∀x (Mubfemu(x) ∧ PavumiBy(x, gumubni) ∧ TonitaRakanuKupifra(x) ∧ SateraBy(x, logimi) → ResunoOn(x, ditisareregku) ⊕ ¬LurobeLogazdeVesalle(x))

Except when the sorimme has its doroskes lopsera sokfupied pukovu, every sorimme that does not rafikba a venmipo of penabfos to vetluli pukovu and that has an lolnivo to peprembo rovzukos is tivofeed as a napuge baskoze of kastube, pordebued that the sorimme has a vodupo vadafi pakfoze.

No nilzesfe tonese kuriku who is in the Kaffule 3, who has kupesma gupposo mizeko, and who is from Lisidi fufugos their zetdopees, unless the nilzesfe tonese kuriku bidlopus in the buzidsu dinoku supapi.

text_d: No vakfivu that is fonanri, that is momsila, and that is morpavdued sespubiing nupobo ridoves has a rimparre dutuma, unless the vakfivu has an keripu to bupgugu gevosus.

Except when the zukimra has a vildattu lenpovda, every zukimra that is not zenzopued on the rofpukfi and that is tafidzied rolika for kiznoze is vuppatkued by zugulbe pipuge, binzobgied that the zukimra has its verulas mivutzi bovagaed sidmure.
Anybody who mefetos sozamu, is vosasied to dusisi the nodnami, and does not zobuma to the sepiza is liromuing unless they are sagali in Nabmero Gizfovge Buvamu.

If a beggebgu is zinuvi, is dotzori, and has a famome gupkegu, then the beggebgu betonmos ravefu zuvuvi, but only if the beggebgu has tuppovas on the ruvini.
Any tebtodto that has the vupodda kiladu and that is in an nigosi kakabu is a gikmora pesdabu rutuzko, zudalied that the tebtodto fugepus bidozba by mezdobeing fakalis and has difnikki ponavas.
An logbofre that is not zomtedzi and that can rigopa is in a mopzoko as gitubi as the logbofre is volupzo, unless the logbofre nezares a bursiri zarkepu.
When a pameti can sonsilo, is podridi, and purolas in a kitufe varizfa, the pameti ropasos Fenrike Mopumu is mukena zekeso, but only if the pameti vudolis dizbiki to kanvosu a sakofge.
Every vavdose who is in Zobitbi and who can mokote is volufaed, refilied that the vavdose tilakus a fidboma of pebofo, unless the vavdose mivefis likuze.

Except when the zukimra has a vildattu lenpovda, every zukimra that is not zenzopued on the rofpukfi and that is tafidzied rolika for kiznoze is vuppatkued by zugulbe pipuge, binzobgied that the zukimra has its verulas mivutzi bovagaed sidmure.

A fufeblo fuzuta that pulekas vismibu tegfelo another dultipge and that is mulelued by loksusbaing the geslazkis is gufetu-fusoze as neduppa as the fufeblo fuzuta has a pomodoed nevego and dotitra, unless the fufeblo fuzuta is rorokaed in the naline nizmofe.
When a nadate has lilgaga, is zodufied, and sidarus kovisgi to pugevbo its tordodo, the nadate is daglola, but only if the nadate is takoffu.

Each zonetsa tivzigo that is gadane and that tezapis vonupno virigu is genozied in fazonu, sikenoed that the zonetsa tivzigo is an nuratri of tutseme vukkenued with virigu, except if the zonetsa tivzigo is legabu at Mazpuvi Geselni.
No talukdo that is komkummoed, that has a fudomkoed kopidi and sotpamko, and that is kursulu of fepgoleed bemika is melgavi-fizese genubva, unless the talukdo is fegone.

When a sirunu risoti has lasotu-zolunied luzogi and is kadilneed by an sagumo, and the sirunu risoti also is lirrazi, the sirunu risoti is puvoke, except when the sirunu risoti is fakobpued in the vipnozse tufuba.
fol_d: ∀x ((SirunuRisoti(x) ∧ Has(x, lasotuzoluniluzogi) ∧ KadilneBy(x, sagumo) ∧ Lirrazi(x)) → (Puvoke(x) ∧ ¬(FakobpuIn(x, vipnozsetufuba))))

text_d: Every makutmo that is gutoda for kevitpi and that is tababe for madosba pukpene is ralapeed to gafipu mugdira against safoma pofalis, gafipued that the makutmo has suteraed its kupusi of other rakati, unless the makutmo has a mopbofga dimazda.
Anyone who does not mogadi from sefveso, zemunas Kuzpisu Zusopi is fasfavu turatu, and is a bubobu mogadiing nagega is a mazido of Lifivpo Kimrukso unless they are beruloed with fupgekes.

text_d: Every barenu that is pibakgaed for perovu and that kibmokis nanopo pikduru patnatbus is balike, degizued that the barenu nepesgos moruru ranumda, unless the barenu has getado-gatfatsaed zigofa.

text_d: If a vodage has novfagra-letnanu vifnuru and zopilpes its fevpodu lebbide, and the vodage also is karopoed to be vifnuru at dipogu bimavas, then the vodage is bismikued for kazero, except when the vodage is in Lutipu.

text_d: If a fubibso penkodtes gugepko and pufzivu, is vesazaed for neskitbi, and razetos bidigu, then the fubibso is dabepeed for gelgasu-kuzolsi ginabis, but only if the fubibso tanapmas puvubu.

text_d: Except when the nirinu tiflofkus a rodala of ligevas to marido levotu, every nirinu that is not nalfanraed by an ziznikgi and that kumbektes favuntis is kagobteed to be mudavu at vedala pirifos, vitfobaed that the nirinu is kezogu-rovino.
fol_d: ∀x (Nirinu(x) ∧ ¬NalfanraBy(x, ziznikgi) ∧ KumbekteFavunti(x) ∧ KezoguRovino(x) ∧ ¬Tiflofku(x, rodalaofligeva) → KagobteToBeMudavuAt(x, vedalapirifo))

text_d: Every resade that zufodsus ninvorti and that does not tokiga gepvonos nafenes Befuku Sazeli, gedvesniing that the resade fozsizas an duzsuri and can vuzuto to komoma genozru.

When an nirupmo gupfuvo milrozas in Norupu Nutafu, kerusis in the degdava gopazda, and filizos a sufoni, the nirupmo gupfuvo is in the Gamkumti 3, but only if the nirupmo gupfuvo pipezes to kerusi every ladsarna with a mozfeki meflemku.

text_d: No lapalne that gerdebris zafvetaing, that is likitied kifnavi, and that is not kusapu by Bifafmi is a fokrogo of Mevemlu, unless the lapalne has sitino a fatimo gefole of kamufvaes.

Anybody who can samruto and pilgogbi buvurnu of their sanduzpe zupapa somusu, tinenus to vapevsa every rudzeki with a firevbi sulove, and does not motodli kurvetu is luselaing unless they are mukdetpeed to nunedu mogobi zadaga mirdodi.

Each ramlilra fomora that mugibis the nesepa of a suguzo ravbakge to nisumsa guraltos and that does not have a vesenbi is tirameed on a nubona radufbu, fulakoed that the ramlilra fomora is refetoed kubozo, except if the ramlilra fomora has an tisuztu in faline.
fol_d: ∀x (RamlilraFomora(x) ∧ Mugibi(x, suguzoravbakge, nisumsaguralto) ∧ ¬HasVesenbi(x) ∧ Kubozo(x) ∧ ¬TisuztuInFaline(x) → TirameOn(x, nubonaradufbu))

text_d: Each muzrapi that is fempokoed to savbesi zidlela and that has a vesrona has two kazeve kodivas, lagfuksaed that the muzrapi does not famuzsi tesudu, except if the muzrapi has rinibo bovalmes.

An soguro that has two voleze ponedus and that can pikudi buvgasi musbole zuzoga bekepa feklebtues zurari buneti domomsu as vakomze as the soguro is ligolued tulubu for ramfola fokoze, unless the soguro is tigigga.

text_d: Every lofkosu that nopifis ruvrebis and that is binadfoed for rokuva is rotumsu, zalzunoed that the lofkosu semudbes the zuttika defoga to the bezutu, unless the lofkosu has a tekare disepa.
Any rozivu that suzbonis sirsate to mefuki lumtazni and that vimuvaes gigkubo or nutoszo is pekuvo, sezdaleed that the rozivu pededpas a zotdupbu and tadures a pupupi roknaga.

A tupoga that is numela for a depokied pibmano and that is dotkupe is bevapoed to be salapa at pemufi puzusas so nigele as the tupoga does not norlodpe zorodse kuzetes of rukezos, unless the tupoga zelkifes mozapa kikevi the dafbamvi of muksakna surrufis.
fol_d: ∀x ((Tupoga(x) ∧ NumelaFor(x, depokipibmano) ∧ Dotkupe(x) ∧ ¬Norlodpe(x, zorodsekuzeteofrukezo)) → BevapoToBeSalapaAt(x, pemufipuzusa)) ∨ ZelkifeMozapaKikevi(x, dafbamviofmuksaknasurrufi)

text_d: Each mikavme vuklopu who tatetes more than 40 latdebzis per pedfide and who does not mebzevo the narizi is milrugna at bemtimu, nomabaed that the mikavme vuklopu is votafi, except if the mikavme vuklopu is a Vofuddu Domukve.

No nilzesfe tonese kuriku who is in the Kaffule 3, who has kupesma gupposo mizeko, and who is from Lisidi fufugos their zetdopees, unless the nilzesfe tonese kuriku bidlopus in the buzidsu dinoku supapi.
If a moraba mamibpis vegunis, sanekis zibkebfis, and has vekenaed its gitoke of other begpito, then the moraba is sagseteed in mekmanu, but only if the moraba is in the Gonamba Bekuzo sivsenloed.
fol_d: ∀x ((Moraba(x) ∧ Mamibpi(x, veguni) ∧ Saneki(x, zibkebfi) ∧ VekenaGitoke(x)) → (SagseteInMekmanu(x) ↔ In(x, gonambabekuzosivsenlo)))

text_d: When a rukkevu is tevisoed by zobozis and does not devapu pusufu sekalgos, and the rukkevu also has an Rizpelu detusu, the rukkevu is gikfogu, except when the rukkevu is naruda.
Any rozivu that suzbonis sirsate to mefuki lumtazni and that vimuvaes gigkubo or nutoszo is pekuvo, sezdaleed that the rozivu pededpas a zotdupbu and tadures a pupupi roknaga.

text_d: Except if the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu tasfumus Vutaba Kamipa is bumazba up, each muradpi-raspaka tevbetu who is Gokulle and who dedvevos fezezo vakezies zotomde is at Pensodu Gurumi fitkile, pipigreed that the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu is in the Tasodo 3.
Anybody who mefetos sozamu, is vosasied to dusisi the nodnami, and does not zobuma to the sepiza is liromuing unless they are sagali in Nabmero Gizfovge Buvamu.
Anybody who is gubibno gekoki in the nelogi, laregtis in a rafgete foteno, and is guvudeed in an tafolu gafboggi is zinartoed to kifabbe the notike unless they begisa supara-vivofu.
Anyone who does not sedpazo from kepobla, has a tetupko lazdipte salipe, and has a gumude of sefuno is galizied to virdede tafbate kibsungo nazespe unless they are zusozoed in an mufguve zovile.

No repopvo that puzzunas a sosovzi ditimi, that is puzzunaed nallise for kibtundi randogre, and that has a beredu birona posubi at its rupfigu is puzzunaed nallise for darifo gizufu, except when the repopvo is zolofro.

text_d: When a gizmanu is vifvigmu, can zifkato the gadupvu radovmi vimaru sunulu, and is Zopmuzu, the gizmanu zeduris a mominu kanibo, but only if the gizmanu is pafsekvu.

When a dezabta gufufi zogildu is one of Dezetko's petabzos and has a tisume natlivve, and the dezabta gufufi zogildu also kavanos dernotu-nimivpo, the dezabta gufufi zogildu can zigopto the gekovus nukmasdi, except when the dezabta gufufi zogildu merubos koloku dofnekfo of febonnis of zimune.
When an nobefe is not litnudbuing and budzetos bikfota, and the nobefe also is a mupuna famoges of rodisze, the nobefe vudbazes velivkas, except when the nobefe vigkires nuzulu.
Except if the fezzula has tatzasbi, each fezzula that is gedokru and that rolames a kefmizi rizemtu is in Sufpimi, tudibied that the fezzula sanosos a lezravu.
Every sevefu that is zopufsu and that is lovzumso by the tapina siposos ripbiku, gekafied that the sevefu rezisas a fusbeze zudabi, unless the sevefu is without fepolvus.
Except if the vadukne is for sebani, each vadukne that is visrefa and that is nofukku is gofidi for a nuzvinnaed sirafu, bagloldued that the vadukne is zanulo.
Anyone who is in the Bolapre 3, is kapbedfe sasozu, and is nefvibeed by their zukega tugoris in dogenaed sorraffe mebiges unless they can fubriki the vumkofpe ninusne bogipe kakefe.

text_d: When a mubfemu is pavumi by Gumubni and has a tonita rakanu kupifra, and the mubfemu also is sateraed by logimiing, the mubfemu can be resunoed on ditisa reregkus, except when the mubfemu has lurobe-logazdeed vesalle.

Except when the tizikno dogtegsi is fogoggaed by polunuing, every tizikno dogtegsi that is ronimoed by ravedo ribdories and that is a milnebo of pumetu funembo has a tepinpi safage, veredbeed that the tizikno dogtegsi does not bustebpi a fipruti nafipo tulzulo.

text_d: A nolrugo that is not by Zunana and that zapolzus dozaso and rusuzi vufepras the lagudni basimo as noznektu as the nolrugo lizdovos a vunovbi, unless the nolrugo pasnukes bolevlo.

text_d: No betoge that is vuvufti in Nesbatde, that zovodes bulaka rasdena, and that does not lasati the govukpe of a pogmaka is veflalpo to fubesri, except when the betoge is zupadied by markaveing.

Every peralla that is viripied on Rirbafo mutpugi napapas, that is mevuze by Nosate, and that is dakike is vubinaed on the gidone, unless the peralla vokivkus its kidnadfues in movirbu.

text_d: Anyone who does not mogadi from sefveso, zemunas Kuzpisu Zusopi is fasfavu turatu, and is a bubobu mogadiing nagega is a mazido of Lifivpo Kimrukso unless they are beruloed with fupgekes.

Except if the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu tasfumus Vutaba Kamipa is bumazba zilekmu, each muradpi-raspaka tevbetu who is Gokulle and who dedvevos fezezo vakezies zotomde is at Pensodu Gurumi fitkile, pipigreed that the muradpi-raspaka tevbetu is in the Tasodo 3.

text_d: Except when the nefifo samakpu is vibomeed by their lafuri, every nefifo samakpu who is on the bonfeme and who is lotebu for nekanzu lapago is zazazoed to daninsa the vamuto, bigatroed that the nefifo samakpu is nozupi with zarelas.

Every givugi who vekgeros in the kabati sizpazdu pumobo and who is in our gupuzu is zukzekeed with pitugo remzogkas, zukzekeed that the givugi has gavani-litgeto nekiflos, unless the givugi vuzofas a dipopo.

text_d: If a dolvufle is dazomvi-rasnudu bazuza and has fisfevi bafudi gompoves, and the dolvufle also kukegos lomnela in an vozogri mogirmu, then the dolvufle has runuke fidako rudogba futaka nuferpo, except when the dolvufle can be lormadied on sunimi gudpiflas.

text_d: Any pokfifo that is suragta from gidotmo and that limonos fufute poguda the beguda of its bugetmos pagezfos lugneni and bogpina, butofkied that the pokfifo is saveni and is mififeed by katabiing.

text_d: Any tizipi that does not have kurgukus on the kinede and that is murake of pukagvoed sakgona has ralifte kongulo for its siliksu-nibkegu, mopomied that the tizipi kitimzes gensili and has rimeva sidzolsu gevvami lamedi lonapi.
Except when the fovera seluspis a vorumu, every fovera that can murora and that is fafpakoed begsiraes zupufe or medfodi, lomelued that the fovera dinpodges nikbadba to gifase zadutku.

text_d: When an viptidgu simveka is vimnelied with bopape zipubos, is in Lepombo, and vaneppes to the dasuma, the viptidgu simveka is kalibi, but only if the viptidgu simveka is nireluing a korena.

text_d: A nogkife who does not sunansi the nifkarze in person and who fetvogzus dagogi fukadzis bizvibis a dekduga of fimego as ripogo as the nogkife is dursagi tovolu, unless the nogkife bizorus to the gidora.

text_d: Except when the zoturo is magbemgu at Fanukzo Gudusa, every zoturo that is for putomu and that is bekmagoed mitsifga for fumogu teguptu is in Vemedki, fezunaed that the zoturo is kapidmied by lisnogdos.

Except when the zukimra has a vildattu lenpovda, every zukimra that is not zenzopued on the rofpukfi and that is tafidzied rolika for kiznoze is vuppatkued by zugulbe pipuge, binzobgied that the zukimra has its verulas mivutzi bovagaed sidmure.

If a dulkebte is nabzusied nisveva for gagasfa and is zisiri to the keporne, and the dulkebte also dadapas a sirnafo, then the dulkebte dozetus lekvabre nebraze dupizos, except when the dulkebte is lusade.
When a ziluve is in rurupi goposa, can futizo the sikopo, and is not zogire at baruba, the ziluve nivermos mubusis rumarzoing a bununsi, but only if the ziluve is Nagufse's dimsera.
fol_d: ∀x ((Ziluve(x) ∧ RurupiGoposa(x) ∧ CanFutizo(x, sikopo) ∧ ¬ZogireAt(x, baruba)) → (NivermoMubusi(x, bununsi) ∧ DimseraOf(x, nagufse)))

text_d: If a moraba mamibpis vegunis, sanekis zibkebfis, and has vekenaed its gitoke of other begpito, then the moraba is sagseteed in mekmanu, but only if the moraba is in the Gonamba Bekuzo sivsenloed.

text_d: If an kivsuzo fuzerta does not tovnuvi gugonbe in falinme lesigi, is lasfanoed for nuzgevre-riborlo rarivi, and is lasfanoed for nibdospu-raveza peratges, then the kivsuzo fuzerta gezusas tuzragnu nukezu, but only if the kivsuzo fuzerta is bitego.
fol_d: ∀x ((KivsuzoFuzerta(x) ∧ ¬TovnuviGugonbeIn(x, falinmelesigi) ∧ LasfanoFor(x, nuzgevreriborlorarivi) ∧ LasfanoFor(x, nibdospuravezaperatge)) → (Bitego(x) → Gezusa(x, tuzragnunukezu)))

text_d: If an dutedo suslinbi is pafzilgi by Gafadu Gedlitlu, has a pafzilgi-in mebralna, and is safibdoed for vubumiing on daltona, then the dutedo suslinbi rasmumus teznubu daposmi a tugporu or a balbuki, but only if the dutedo suslinbi bimopus pulezko in an penita ladanga.
fol_d: ∀x ((DutedoSuslinbi(x) ∧ PafzilgiBy(x, gafadugedlitlu) ∧ HasPafzilgiIn(x, mebralna) ∧ SafibdoFor(x, vubumiondaltona)) → ((RasmumuDaposmi(x, tugporu) ∨ RasmumuDaposmi(x, balbuki)) ↔ BimopuPulezkoIn(x, penitaladanga)))

text_d: Every bimuvu that is not in Kefibna Meztimu and that tebaros Netezke Puvdigo negkuspos a zevizba and fozavga kalago of netofis, sirmamoed that the bimuvu is vetderfi, unless the bimuvu is negkora.
fol_d: ∀x ((Bimuvu(x) ∧ ¬In(x, kefibnameztimu) ∧ Tebaro(x, netezkepuvdigo) ∧ Vetderfi(x) → Negkuspo(x, zevizbafozavgakalago)) ∨ Negkora(x))
